title: Travel Agency / Safe Travels with Steve Youtube
description:
Virtual Assistant — Travel Business, Mailchimp & Website Support



Remote | Part-Time | Approximately 30 Hours per Week

Starting Pay: US $3 per Hour | Opportunity for Increased Earnings and Responsibility



Help me build something—and grow with it.



I’m Steve Bowles, a travel agency owner and retired police commander. I’m looking for a resourceful, organized virtual assistant to support my travel company and help launch Safe Travels with Steve, my new podcast, website, and travel content brand.



My travel business focuses on memorable vacations, cruises, and group experiences. Safe Travels with Steve will help people explore the world with greater confidence through practical safety advice, destination information, travel gear, and real-world experiences.



I bring the ideas, travel experience, relationships, and on-camera content. I’m looking for someone who can help turn those ideas into action—keeping the business organized, improving our online presence, and helping us reach more people.



I am hiring a separate video editor. Your primary focus will be virtual assistance, Mailchimp, website development and updates, and business coordination. Video editing is not required.



Your Main Responsibilities



Travel Business & Administrative Support



Organize client inquiries, follow-ups, calendars, and deadlines.



Draft
s, travel summaries, itineraries, and client communications for my review.



Research cruises, destinations, hotels, tours, and travel suppliers.



Help coordinate group travel, guest information, planning checklists, and payment reminders.



Maintain accurate client records, spreadsheets, and digital files.



Track projects and keep me informed about priorities, missing information, and next steps.



Travel industry experience is helpful, but accuracy, initiative, and willingness to learn are essential. Pricing, bookings, and commitments to clients require my approval.



Mailchimp &
 Marketing



Help set up, organize, and manage Mailchimp.



Create attractive, mobile-friendly
 templates that fit our brands.



Prepare newsletters, travel promotions, group trip announcements, and podcast updates.



Maintain audience lists, tags, segments, and signup forms.



Help build welcome
s and simple automated
 sequences.



Check links, formatting, and details before approved campaigns are sent.



Monitor results and suggest practical ways to improve engagement.



Please describe what you have personally done in Mailchimp. If you have used another
 marketing platform, explain which skills would transfer and what you would need to learn.



Website Development & Ongoing Updates



Help develop and launch a professional, easy-to-use website for Safe Travels with Steve.



Build and update pages using WordPress or another agreed platform.



Publish articles, podcast episodes, videos, travel resources, and promotions.



Create landing pages and connect Mailchimp signup forms.



Keep links, images, contact forms, and page information current.



Check that pages work well on phones and computers.



Handle routine updates within your abilities and coordinate with a specialist when needed.



I need someone comfortable doing hands-on website work. You do not need to be an advanced programmer, but please be specific about what you can build, maintain, and troubleshoot independently.



Podcast & Content Coordination



Organize the tasks needed to launch the podcast.



Maintain a content calendar and publishing schedule.



Coordinate files, instructions, and deadlines with my video editor.



Research topics and potential guests.



Draft episode descriptions, show notes, social captions, and website articles.



Upload and schedule approved content.



Create simple graphics and promotional materials in Canva.



We will set priorities together so the workload stays realistic within the agreed hours.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?



Someone who:



Communicates clearly in written English.



Is dependable, organized, and attentive to details.



Takes initiative and follows through.



Has practical experience with Mailchimp and website platforms.



Is comfortable using Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and Canva.



Can research information and verify its accuracy.



Protects confidential client and business information.



Has reliable internet and a suitable computer.



Can attend scheduled check-ins during mutually agreed hours. I am based in California.



I value honesty about your abilities. You do not need to know everything—but you should be willing to learn, ask good questions, and take pride in your work.



Starting Pay & Your Opportunity to Grow



This position starts at US $3 per hour for approximately 30 hours per week.



I’m looking for a long-term team member who wants to help build these businesses with me. My intention is for your compensation to grow in step with your contribution, expanding responsibilities, and the growth of the business.



As you demonstrate dependable work, develop your skills, improve our systems, and help our marketing reach more clients and viewers, I want to recognize that progress through opportunities for higher pay and greater responsibility.



We will have regular conversations about performance, goals, and compensation. Increases will depend on demonstrated results and the business’s ability to support them; there is no guaranteed amount or timeline.



You will have a meaningful role in what we build. I want someone who can look back with pride and say, “I helped make that happen”—and share in the opportunities that growth creates.



How to Apply — Read Carefully



 your application directly to: 



Applications submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph messages will not be considered. This is my way of eliminating the spammers.



Use this exact subject line:



Ready for Takeoff — VA Application — [Your Full Name]



Please include:



A brief introduction: Why does this specific opportunity interest you?



Mailchimp experience: What have you personally created or managed? Include a sample if available.



Website experience: Which platforms do you use, and what can you build or update independently? Include links and explain your contribution.



Administrative experience: Describe how you manage competing tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.



Your strongest skills and training needs: Be honest about both.



Availability: Your time zone, available weekly hours, earliest start date, and availability for California-based check-ins.



Pay confirmation: Confirm that you understand and accept the starting rate of US $3 per hour.



A short practical answer: We are promoting a new group cruise through a website page and Mailchimp
. What information would you need from me, and what would you check before either goes live?



Remove confidential information from any work samples.



Finish your
 by answering: “What would you take off my plate in your first week, and what would you like to grow into over the next year?”



Write in your own voice. Specific, thoughtful answers matter more than a polished, generic cover letter.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a brief interview and a small, paid skills exercise.



If you enjoy travel, like bringing order to a busy business, and want the chance to grow alongside something you helped build, I’d like to hear from you.



Steve Bowles

Travel Agency Owner | Founder, Safe Travels with Steve

title: Amazon Manager

Who We Are

Sunbelt Products is a small but successful and growing eCommerce company based in Odessa, FL that has been in business for more than 15 years. In 2011 we started in a modest 600 square foot warehouse and over the years have progressively grown into a 25,000 square foot operation. 

We sell our own branded products (Liquid Stands, Pink Power, Sleepavo, HTM Lighting) that are manufactured to our specifications and listed on various channels such as Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Reverb, Target, and our own websites. We fulfill orders in our warehouse and we prepare for and ship products to Amazon and Walmart warehouses for them to fulfill. 



Why Join Us

Ready for a change? You will be joining a small but highly dynamic, dedicated, and motivated team. We value continuous improvement and are readily open to new ideas and suggestions. Each individual can and does make a difference! 



About the Position

Sunbelt Products is seeking a dedicated Amazon Manager to join our growing team. This role will lead the engagement and the day-to-day business strategy for Amazon. 

The Amazon Channel Manager will create and implement strategic growth plans in collaboration with the whole Channel Management Team. He/She will also be responsible for sustaining and continuous development of the company’s Amazon account. 

The ideal candidate must be highly motivated and an expert in all aspects of Amazon. You’ll be an integral part of the Channel Management Team in assisting on the expansion of our brands and excellent sales.





This position is fully remote and follows a Monday through Friday work schedule with weekends off.



What You Will Do

Hire, mentor, develop and coach all direct reports.

Drive the achievement of agreed internal and external KPIs and standards. 

Ensure all SOPs are maintained properly, well-organized, and implemented.

Enhance, optimize, and execute sales and marketing strategies for Amazon marketplace's growth and achievement of KPI's .

Own all Amazon related processes. 

Keep up to date with new features and trends. 

Create, streamline and manage reports to achieve success

Manage FBA inventory levels to prevent out of stocks while also avoiding unnecessary storage fees.

Work and strategize with internal teams on Amazon advertising initiatives to boost revenue and enhance brand growth.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree

Minimum of 2 years Amazon Seller Central experience.

Proficient with Excel/Google Sheets.

Gathering and analyzing data.

Strong problem solving skills

Excellent command of the English language.

title: Technical QA Engineer (Laravel + Vue 2, post-deploy), EU property-tech + SaaS, remote
description:
Role

We ship small changes to our live platforms often. We want a technical QA engineer with a real developer background: you think like a user, but you can also read the code path, review merge requests, and tell us when the fix or the AI-suggested change should be different. After each release you check that landlords, renters, candidates and companies can still get from A to B to C. You are not the person who builds features full time, but you are close to a half-developer on our stack. Speed and quality, not one at the cost of the other.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We run several live rental and property platforms on one shared Laravel and Vue 2 codebase, plus a recruitment SaaS where candidates record video intakes for companies and agencies. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



Where you sit in our flow

We roll out to production often and we want to keep that pace. Developers deploy; you are not a gate before release and you do not own the deploy button. After each production rollout you test on
 the journeys that release touched, then the critical paths users depend on, on desktop and mobile, with test accounts and safe paths where we need them. You are the second check after go-live, not a blocker in front of it. When something fails for a real user, you report it fast with steps, expected versus actual, and enough detail that a developer can fix it the same day.



How we work

Our developers work with AI coding assistants and keep their changes small. You test the outcome in the browser and you sanity-check the change in GitLab: read the diff, spot risky patterns, and push back when generated code is sloppy or the wrong layer was touched. If something works on paper but feels wrong in the browser, you say so. You may use AI tools yourself, but the pass or fail comes from what you verified, not from what the model claimed.



What you will do

- After each production rollout, smoke-test the journeys that release touched, on desktop and on mobile

- Re-run the critical journeys per product: listing a property, booking a viewing, uploading documents, recording a video intake, reviewing candidates

- Explore beyond the release note when something looks fragile

- Check that a change on one platform did not break or leak into another platform on the same codebase

- Write clear bug reports: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual, severity, environment, browser and device, screenshot or short video

- Point developers to the file, layer, or request: Blade, Vue component, controller, query, or API response

- Give UX feedback in plain words, for example "a landlord would not know what to do here"

- Review merge requests and recent commits: what changed, what could regress, what should have been tested, what you would do differently

- Suggest concrete improvements to developers (and to AI-generated patches): safer query, clearer validation, better error handling, smaller scope



Requirements

- Strong technical background: you have worked as a developer or as QA embedded with developers, and you can read Laravel and Vue 2 code in a real codebase, not only tutorials

- Hands-on experience with Laravel web applications and Vue 2 front ends in production, or equivalent depth with a similar PHP plus SPA stack and a clear plan to work in our Vue 2 patterns

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant products: one codebase, several sites or customers, and you know how a fix on one brand can break another

- Proven QA on live web products, with examples where your report or your review caught something others missed

- You think in user journeys and in the people behind them

- Clear written English, short and precise

- Solid GitLab or GitHub habits: branches, merge requests, reading diffs, commenting on specific lines

- Browser developer tools: console, network tab, status codes; you tie UI symptoms to backend responses

- Comfortable challenging AI-assisted development: you review output like a senior teammate, not like a checklist-only tester

- Reliable and self-directed: you find the next useful check without being told

- This role is QA and review first. We do not hire you primarily to ship features. Occasional tiny fixes are a bonus, not the job description.



Nice to have

- Accessibility basics: keyboard use, contrast, readable forms

- Ideas for light automated checks or regression notes, without making automation the whole role

- Docker-based local setup or Laravel Mix familiarity



Working hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Amsterdam time. That is 15:00 to 23:00 in the Philippines in European summer, and 16:00 to 00:00 when Europe switches to winter time. Please state your timezone and the window you can reliably cover each workday.



Paid trial (before full engagement)

A paid trial week of about five working days, full time, at $3 per hour, tracked with TimeProof after signing. We give you test accounts, a short list of recent rollouts to verify the same way you would after go-live, and read-only visibility on merge requests where useful. You test like a real user on desktop and mobile, file bug reports and UX notes, and add technical review comments where you see risk in the change. You may use AI tools, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you report and every review comment.



The deal

Remote, full time, long term. Hours are tracked with TimeProof. Rate: $3 per hour to start, reviewed on quality and impact. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Start your message with ABC.

2) One bug you found in production that others missed: how you reproduced it and how you reported it.

3) How you would test a release right after it goes live, without slowing every release down.

4) One example of UX feedback you gave that changed a flow.

5) A form submits and nothing happens. What do you send the developer?

6) One merge request or diff you reviewed: what you looked at in the code, what you worried about, and what you asked the developer to change.

7) Your timezone and the Amsterdam-time window you can cover.



Keep it short. Selected applicants do a short video intake on our platform before we talk.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work

- You only know QA in theory and cannot give real examples

- You have never read application code or merge request diffs in a real job

- You only write automated tests and do not think about the people using the product

- You want a pure development role with no testing responsibility

- You cannot write clear English

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Logistics and QA coordinator
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We're looking for a highly organised logistics and quality assurance coordinator with exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish.



Your main responsibility will be making sure our projects are properly prepared, materials arrive correctly and on time, and all required QA documentation is completed, checked and filed.



We need someone who is proactive, works efficiently and identifies problems before they cause delays or additional costs.



This is not simply an administrative role. We want someone who takes responsibility for keeping things organised, following up outstanding items and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Key responsibilities



Logistics and material coordination



• Coordinate material orders, supplier deliveries, freight and equipment movements across our Australian projects.



• Review purchase orders, drawings, specifications and material lists to confirm the correct items and quantities have been ordered.



• Track supplier manufacturing progress, dispatch dates, delivery schedules and outstanding components.



• Coordinate with suppliers and freight providers to confirm packing lists, shipment details, dimensions, weights and delivery requirements.



• Arrange freight consolidation where materials from multiple suppliers need to be combined into a single delivery.



• Coordinate receiving inspections with suppliers and logistics partners to verify materials against approved lists before dispatch.



• Obtain packing photos, delivery records and supporting documentation to confirm materials are complete and correctly identified.



• Identify shortages, incorrect components, damaged materials and delivery discrepancies. Follow through until resolved.



• Coordinate movement of tools, lifting equipment and other company assets between projects.



• Confirm site delivery requirements, including access, unloading equipment, delivery contacts and any restrictions.



• Maintain accurate records of material orders, deliveries, equipment movements and outstanding items.



Quality assurance and document control



• Maintain accurate QA records for projects from initial procurement through to completion.



• Prepare, review and track inspection and test plans (ITPs), QA checklists, material certificates and supporting documentation.



• Check documentation for completeness, consistency and correct project details before submitting it for technical approval.



• Review inspection photographs, site records and supporting evidence to confirm that required documentation has been provided.



• Identify missing signatures, incomplete inspection records, incorrect document revisions and conflicting information.



• Coordinate with suppliers, engineers, site supervisors and subcontractors to obtain outstanding QA documentation.



• Maintain defect registers, nonconformance records and rectification action lists.



• Track outstanding defects and corrective actions until the responsible person confirms completion.



• Ensure current approved drawings, procedures and specifications are available to the relevant team members.



• Coordinate completion reports, inspection reports, warranty documentation and final handover packages.



• Maintain organised project folders and document registers so records can be located easily.



Technical and engineering approvals remain the responsibility of the appropriate qualified personnel. Your role is to make sure the information is complete, accurate and ready for review.



Project preparation and operational support



• Review upcoming projects and identify outstanding requirements before mobilisation.



• Confirm required materials, equipment, tools and documentation are ready before work is scheduled to begin.



• Coordinate site access requirements, inductions, licences, certificates and other necessary approvals.



• Work with our operations team to confirm site readiness and any outstanding client responsibilities.



• Track installation schedules, supplier commitments and delivery deadlines.



• Identify potential delays early and communicate them clearly to the relevant team members.



• Follow up with site supervisors to obtain daily records, photographs, completed checklists and outstanding QA evidence.



• Keep project status, outstanding actions and key dates updated in our management systems.



• Support the operations and accounts teams by identifying outstanding documentation or approvals that may delay project milestones and payments.



• Ensure projects have a clear record of outstanding items and responsibilities through to final completion.



Communication and attention to detail



Strong communication is essential. You'll be dealing with our Australian team, suppliers, transport companies, engineers and clients.



We expect someone who can communicate clearly, ask precise questions and follow through without constant reminders.



• Read relevant
s, drawings and supporting documents before responding.



• Understand the actual issue before asking questions or requesting further information.



• Write clear, natural and professional
s.



• Be confident making phone calls when they will resolve an issue faster than
.



• Confirm important details rather than making assumptions.



• Check job numbers, drawings, quantities, specifications, delivery addresses and attachments before sending.



• Keep the right people informed when something changes or requires attention.



• Take ownership of outstanding tasks until they are resolved or properly handed over.



We need someone who can produce accurate work with minimal correction. Being busy is not the same as making progress. We value people who finish what they start.



Improve how we work



We're looking for someone who can improve our logistics and QA processes, not just follow existing procedures.



This includes helping us build and maintain reliable checklists, material registers, QA templates and project tracking systems.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to review documents, organise information, prepare correspondence and reduce repetitive administration.



You must be able to check AI generated information against the original documents and recognise when something requires further review.



We want someone who actively identifies opportunities to reduce errors, avoid unnecessary costs and make our operations more efficient.



What we're looking for



• Experience in logistics coordination, construction administration, quality assurance, document control, procurement or a similar role.



• Experience working with construction, engineering, manufacturing or industrial projects is highly desirable.



• Exceptional attention to detail and consistent accuracy.



• Excellent written and spoken English. You must be articulate, professional and confident communicating with Australian clients and suppliers.



• Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills, including maintaining registers, tracking records and checking data.



• Ability to read and understand technical drawings, material lists, specifications and project documentation.



• Familiarity with QA procedures, ITPs, inspection records and controlled documentation is highly desirable.



• Experience coordinating suppliers, freight, deliveries and project materials.



• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.



• Confidence using ChatGPT, AI tools and other technology to improve productivity.



• Experience with Pipedrive, ServiceM8, Google Workspace or similar systems would be an advantage.



• Initiative, accountability and consistent follow through.



You should not need repeated reminders to chase suppliers, update records, follow up outstanding documents or complete assigned tasks.



About the role



This is a remote position working with our Australian team during agreed Australian business hours.



We will provide training on our products, systems and internal processes. However, you must already have strong organisational skills, attention to detail and professional communication abilities.



You will work closely with our operations, engineering, procurement and project management teams.



Performance will be measured by:



• Material accuracy and delivery coordination.



• Completeness and accuracy of QA documentation.



• Timely identification and resolution of outstanding issues.



• Reliable project updates and follow through.



• Reduction in avoidable delays, missing materials and documentation errors.



• Clear, responsive communication with the team, suppliers and clients.



There is an opportunity to grow into a broader operations or quality management role as you develop your understanding of the business.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or links to download your video.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your experience with logistics, QA, document control or project coordination.



• How you would prevent missing or incorrect materials from being delivered to a construction site.



• How you manage multiple outstanding tasks and ensure nothing gets forgotten.



• One practical example of how you have used AI or automation to improve your work.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same WhatsApp chat. Include your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical exercise covering material reconciliation, QA document checking, attention to detail and client communication.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Project manager and QA coordinator (Remote)
description:
Remote | Philippines based | Australian company | Immediate start



Raven Engineering Group specialises in water storage tanks, engineering, installation, refurbishment and maintenance projects across Australia.



We’re looking for an organised, confident project manager to take ownership of our projects from sales handover through to completion and final payment.



We typically have around 40 active projects at different stages. We need someone who keeps jobs moving, follows through and makes sure the required checks happen before work proceeds.



This is a remote coordination and management role. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must understand construction project delivery and be comfortable working with drawings, specifications and quality records.



You will work closely with our design, procurement, installation and accounts teams. You must be available during agreed Australian business hours to support our site crews and clients.



Pay and progression



Starting rate is USD $8 per hour, with the opportunity to progress to USD $10 to $12 per hour based on demonstrated performance and ownership.



Progression will depend on results, attention to detail and your ability to manage projects independently and improve how we work.



The position is available to start immediately.



Project management responsibilities



• Manage approximately 40 active projects at different stages, from sales handover through to completion and final payment.

• Maintain accurate project records, tasks, responsibilities and follow ups in Pipedrive and ServiceM8.

• Coordinate engineering, estimating, procurement, installation and accounts.

• Track schedules, manufacturing, deliveries, installation dates and deadlines.

• Follow up on drawing approvals, purchase orders, outstanding information and client decisions.

• Track budgets, costs, variations and payment milestones. Ensure changes are recorded and the required approvals are obtained.

• Coordinate invoicing with accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.

• Lead project meetings, assign actions and make sure agreed tasks are completed.

• Identify delays and problems early. Resolve what you can and escalate decisions with clear facts and proposed next steps.

• Provide concise progress updates showing priorities, overdue actions and decisions needed.



Quality assurance and project readiness



Your role includes making sure the right checks happen before materials are installed and before work is covered or crews leave site.



• Confirm site teams have the current approved drawings, scope, material requirements and checklists.

• Coordinate checks of delivered materials against approved specifications, including product codes, delivery records and certificates.

• Ensure material substitutions and changes to the approved design are referred to the responsible person for written approval before use.

• Maintain records of required licences, training, insurance, inductions and permits. Flag missing or expired documents before mobilisation.

• Coordinate required inspections and hold points. A hold point is a stage where work cannot proceed until the required check and approval are complete.

• Review daily site updates, photos and forms for completeness. Follow up on missing or unclear evidence promptly.

• Maintain a register of defects, departures from approved requirements and corrective actions, with an owner and due date for each item.

• Before crews leave site, confirm the responsible supervisor has checked the work and any remaining items have an agreed plan and approval.

• Organise completion records, warranties, handover documents and client sign offs.



You will have management support to hold mobilisation or affected work where required checks or approvals are missing.



Technical decisions and engineering certification remain with the responsible qualified people. Site supervisors remain responsible for checking physical materials and workmanship. Your responsibility is to make sure these checks happen, the evidence is recorded and outstanding items are closed.



Improve how we work



We want someone who spots recurring problems and introduces practical improvements.



This includes improving project handovers, material checks, checklists, reporting and document control.



You should be comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to help review information, prepare reports and identify gaps. You must check the output and know when an issue needs a person with technical expertise.



What we’re looking for



• Proven experience managing multiple projects in construction, engineering, manufacturing or a similar environment.

• Strong attention to detail and consistent follow through.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to Australian clients, suppliers and site teams.

• Confidence to lead meetings, ask direct questions and hold people accountable.

• The ability to read project drawings and specifications well enough to identify discrepancies and raise clear questions.

• Experience coordinating QA records, inspections, material approvals or project closeout.

• Strong organisation and the ability to prioritise a busy workload independently.

• Commercial awareness and confidence tracking budgets, variations and payments.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence using project management systems.

• Pipedrive and ServiceM8 experience is highly desirable.

• Confidence using AI tools while applying your own judgement.



We need someone who takes ownership, raises problems early and follows them through. You should not need constant reminders to complete tasks or chase outstanding actions.



How to apply



Send a one minute introductory video and your CV directly to Matt on WhatsApp:




Record and send your video directly in the WhatsApp chat. Only videos playable within the chat will be viewed. Do not send Google Drive links, cloud storage links or download links.



In your video, briefly explain:



• Your relevant project management and QA experience.

• The systems you have used, including Pipedrive or ServiceM8.

• How you keep track of multiple projects.

• One example of a mistake you prevented or a process you improved.



Send your CV as an attachment in the same chat. Confirm your earliest start date and availability during Australian business hours.



Applications without a video sent directly in WhatsApp will not be considered.

title: Senior Finance Manager / Controller
description:
Full time, 40 hours a week, spread across 7 days. Remote, based in the Philippines. Reports to the CEO. Flexible daily working hours, with a consistent reporting deadline of 1:00 PM PHT: 



We are a 24/7 business. That is why the week is 7 days and not 5. The hours are normal, the rhythm is not. 



We are a two entity, two market, inventory heavy DTC beauty business running on Shopify and Amazon with China direct and 3PL fulfilment. Revenue is not our problem. Visibility is.



We need a qualified accountant who turns a messy, cross border operation into a small set of numbers we can look at every single day and trust. Not a month end role. Not a board deck role. A daily discipline role.



The rhythm is the point: a report lands every morning, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. We spend money on ads every day, so we need to see profit and cash every day. Weekends are when problems hide.



The Philippines time zone is a deliberate advantage here. You work your morning, the previous European day has just closed, and your pack is in Slack before Amsterdam opens.



You will work alongside our existing external accounting partners (a US accounting firm, Dutch bookkeepers and a cross border accountant) rather than replacing them. They handle statutory and compliance. You own management reporting.



The daily rhythm

Every day, 7 days a week, delivered by 13:00 PHT (around 07:00 CET).



• Cash position across all bank accounts and both entities

• Yesterday’s revenue, gross profit and ad spend by market and channel

• Blended MER and contribution margin after ad spend

• Refunds, chargebacks and payment provider reserve movements

• Any red flag, called out in one line at the top

Weekend versions can be a lighter, largely templated snapshot, but they land.



Every Monday:

• Full management P&L for the prior week

• Contribution margin by SKU, channel and market

• Inventory position and stock cover in weeks

• Rolling 13 week cash flow forecast, updated

• KPI pack for the founding team



Every month:

• Consolidated cross border P&L (NL and US) and balance sheet review

• Variance against plan, with commentary on the why

• Reconciliation sign off across Shopify, Amazon, payment providers, 3PL and the ledger



What You’ll Own Beyond the Reporting

• Cash forecasting: the rolling 13 week forecast, including inventory and purchase order cash planning against production lead times

• Unit economics: true landed COGS per SKU (freight, duty, fulfilment), and contribution margin by SKU, channel, market and cohort

• Channel P&Ls: Shopify DACH, Shopify US, Amazon US, comparable and reconciled

• Payment risk monitoring: reserves, rolling reserves and chargeback exposure

• FX exposure across EUR, USD and PHP

• Invoice verification: supplier and 3PL invoices checked against contracted terms

• Automation: templates, defined metrics, connected data sources. If the daily pack takes two hours by month three, something is wrong



What We’re Looking For

• Philippine CPA, or an equivalent qualification with a strong practical track record

• 4+ years in accounting or finance, including hands on management reporting

• Ecommerce or inventory based business experience

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You have built cash flow models yourself

• Comfortable reconciling data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, payment gateways and 3PL reports

• Multi currency and multi entity experience

• Reliable to a fault. A pack that lands 6 days out of 7 is worth a fraction of one that lands 7

• Willing to work a 7 day rhythm with light weekend days, and to cover Philippine public holidays 

• Excellent written English and the confidence to tell a CEO a number he will not like



Strong Plus

• Beauty, cosmetics or CPG experience

• Experience reporting for a Western or European company from the Philippines

• BI or automation skills (Looker Studio, Power BI, SQL, Zapier or similar)

• Familiarity with NL and US cross border reporting

• Xero, QuickBooks or a comparable cloud ledger



First 90 Days Looks Like Success If

1. The daily pack has landed every day for 30 consecutive days and leadership trusts it

2. A 13 week rolling cash forecast is live, updated weekly, and reliable enough to make decisions on

3. True landed COGS and contribution margin are known per SKU and per channel

4. The daily pack takes under 45 minutes to produce because the rest is automated



What We Offer

• Fully remote, permanently

• Direct access to the CEO

• Genuine ownership of the finance function as it grows

• HMO health coverage and 13th month pay

• Paid monthly via Wise



What to Include in Your Application

• Your CPA registration number, or the equivalent qualification with the body that issued it

• One management report you built yourself, redacted as needed, so we can see the format and the metrics you chose

• The names of the systems you have reconciled across, and for which business

• Confirmation in writing that you are available on a 7 day rhythm

title: Platform Tester (H-1B / PERM) — USImmigration.ai
description:
About the role



USImmigration.ai is looking for a contract Platform Tester with deep, hands-on H-1B and PERM experience to help us build out and test the H-1B and PERM functionality of our platform.



USImmigration.ai is a case management and AI intake/retainer platform built for U.S. immigration law firms. 

We are expanding the platform to fully support H-1B (including LCA) and EB-2/EB-3 PERM cases. 

We have two testers already; neither has H-1B or PERM experience. You would be our subject-matter expert for these case types.

This is not a click-through QA role. You will test what the platform produces against what an experienced H-1B/PERM paralegal or attorney would expect, and you will tell our developers how the platform should work: what screens, fields, workflows, and documents are needed to run these cases well. Your input will shape the product directly, including upcoming DOL-related workflows and integrations. 

Final legal interpretations and compliance-sensitive requirements will be reviewed and approved by qualified U.S. immigration counsel.



What you'll do

Test the platform's H-1B and PERM outputs

Run full H-1B and PERM cases through the platform using fictional/synthetic case data and documents that you build to mirror real-world scenarios (change of status, cap-subject, cap-exempt, amendments, transfers, extensions; PERM with and without special recruitment, professional vs. non-professional, audit scenarios)

Review every output the platform generates (questionnaires, forms, LCA and ETA-9089 data, support letters, recruitment summaries, checklists, deadline calculations) for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with how an experienced practitioner would prepare the case

Evaluate the compliance workflows around the case, not just the filings: for H-1B, LCA posting and public access file requirements, wage obligations, material-change and amendment triggers, and filing deadlines; for PERM, prevailing wage, recruitment documentation, supervised recruitment, audit file retention, and filing deadlines

Log clear, reproducible bug reports and accuracy issues, ranked by severity, with screenshots and the expected result

Re-test fixes and confirm they are correct before they ship

Design how the platform should work

Write product requirements for H-1B and PERM features: case workflows, intake questionnaires, required fields, document checklists, deadline rules, and status stages

Propose screen layouts, field groupings, and navigation that make the platform fast and intuitive for paralegals and attorneys who run high volumes of these cases

Compare our platform against the leading immigration case management software you have used and identify what we are missing or doing worse

Help define Phase 2 scope, including DOL-related workflows and potential integrations (FLAG/LCA preparation and filing support, PERM preparation and audit tracking, prevailing wage), USCIS case status tracking, and recruitment management, subject to technical feasibility and applicable system access requirements

Review developer mockups and builds and give direct written feedback before and after implementation

Work with the team

Join regular calls with the founders and the development team

Keep a running test plan and feature backlog for H-1B and PERM

Coordinate with our two existing testers so coverage and reporting are consistent across case types



What we're looking for

Required

5+ years of hands-on H-1B and PERM case work at a U.S. immigration law firm or corporate immigration team, start to finish: LCA preparation, certification, and public access files; H-1B petition assembly (I-129, H Supplement, support letters, RFE responses) and amendment analysis; prevailing wage determinations; PERM recruitment and recruitment documentation, including supervised recruitment; ETA-9089 preparation; and audit file preparation and responses



Substantial daily use (3+ years preferred) of a sophisticated immigration case management platform with strong H-1B/PERM workflows (for example INSZoom, LawLogix Guardian, Docketwise, Cerenade eIMMIGRATION, or a comparable system), including questionnaires, form generation, document assembly, and deadline tracking



Able to look at a form, letter, or data output and spot what is wrong, missing, or risky



Able to write clear product requirements and feature proposals: you can describe what a screen or workflow should do, why, and how a paralegal would use it



Strong written English and comfortable giving direct feedback to developers



Based in the Philippines and available to work as an independent contractor with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific time



Nice to have



Experience with other employment-based categories (EB-1, EB-2 NIW, L-1, O-1, TN, E-2)

Prior QA, UAT, or product/implementation work on a legal or SaaS platform (writing test plans, bug tracking, acceptance testing)

Familiarity with DOL FLAG, iCERT history, and USCIS online filing systems

Experience configuring or administering a case management platform (templates, workflows, custom fields)

Basic familiarity with tools like Jira, Trello, Notion, Loom, or Figma





Confidentiality and test data. 

You will sign a confidentiality agreement. 

Testing uses only fictional/synthetic case files, company-provided data, or public materials.

Real client materials from any current or former employer may not be used in any form, including redacted, and doing so is grounds for immediate termination.



Equipment. You will need a reliable computer, stable internet, and a quiet place to take video calls.

USImmigration.ai Inc. is a California corporation based in Woodland Hills, CA.

title: Virtual Assistant for UK Block Manager
description:
Virtual Assistant for UK Block Manager (remote, 20 hours a week)



About the role A UK residential block management company is looking for a dedicated virtual assistant to support its team. They manage residential developments and buildings, and want someone who becomes a genuine extension of the team, not general admin support. Ideally you have UK property management experience, particularly block or leasehold management. We will also consider an experienced property management assistant who can be trained in the more specialist areas. A big part of the role is ownership and follow-through. There are a lot of moving parts across different developments, so you need to be organised, confident with contractors and residents, and comfortable chasing things until they are resolved.



What you will be doing



Keeping the property management inbox under control every day, with
s answered promptly, and answering straightforward leaseholder and resident queries from the company's templates and procedures

Logging maintenance issues and coordinating contractors: getting and chasing quotations, arranging access with residents, leaseholders and contractors, and following works through to completion

Getting the approval of the management company's directors before any contractor is told to go ahead, and keeping residents and directors updated on works

Keeping the contractor, property and development records up to date

Updating compliance trackers and watching renewal dates: fire risk assessments, EICRs, fire alarm testing, emergency lighting, asbestos inspections and other building compliance

Helping with Section 20 administration and keeping consultation records in order

Helping with service charge administration and routine arrears chasing, following the company's procedures

Processing and organising contractor invoices and preparing bookkeeping information (Xero experience helps)

Updating spreadsheets, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 records

Preparing and sending routine letters, notices and resident communications from approved templates

Helping with AGM and directors' meeting administration: circulating documents and following up actions

Researching contractors and suppliers when needed, and keeping a task list you chase yourself, without waiting to be prompted Over time, as you learn the developments and the way the company works, more of the routine operational workload will be handed to you.

What we need from you



Experience of UK property management, ideally block or leasehold management. If you do not have the specialist side yet, strong experience as a property management or admin assistant, and the ability to learn it

Clear, professional written English and confidence communicating with contractors and residents

Organisation and ownership: you follow a job through and say early when something is wrong

Care with deadlines. A missed compliance or renewal date is the thing we cannot have

To live in the Philippines

A Core i5 or Ryzen 5 class computer or better, with 8GB RAM

Internet of at least 10 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up Useful: Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Xero, and block management software (the team uses Dwellant).

Pay and the practical details



Paid in US dollars, $4 to $6 an hour depending on experience, every week for the hours you clock. That is about $80 to $120 a week at 20 hours

20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, starting at 09:00 UK time. Fixed shifts in UK business hours, the same times every week

Paid holiday, two paid personal days a year, Christmas Day and Boxing Day off, paid breaks

Your contract and pay are with Mango & Co., and a UK contact at Mango & Co. is there for you

Remote, working with one UK business



How to apply The application takes about 20 minutes: your set-up, your experience and a few questions about the role. Then a short aptitude test, a typing test, two references and a short video. Read every question: missing an instruction is the most common reason an application goes no further. When you write about your experience, include the reference code BLK-OPS in your answer. We tell you the outcome either way.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Video Editor (AI Native)
description:
The Role

We are searching for a number of freelance video editors who can produce social video ads end to end: generating footage and assets with AI video platforms (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo and similar), and editing them into finished vertical ads for TikTok and Instagram, complete with captions, on-screen text, sound effects and music. You will work from an approved script, an editor brief and a set of references on every job. Confident daily use of video generation models is central to the role, as well as creative judgement. The brief sets the direction, and you bring the ideas, taste and craft that make the ad worth watching. 



*** Outstanding editors can earn $500 - $1000 USD+ a week!



About Us

We are a UK-based production agency creating social video ads for consumer brands, including well-known names in beauty, wellness, sport and consumer goods. 



Main Responsibilities

- Editing paid social video ads from our scripts and editor briefs.

- Generating A-roll and B-roll using AI video platforms, following our prompts and art direction.

- Adding native-style captions, on-screen text, sound design and music to brief.

- Understanding the technicals of production and delivering based on video specifications 

- Following briefs exactly and delivering on time, every time.

- Revising edits based on feedback, quickly and without drama.



Essential Requirements:

You must have skills in all of the following. If you do not have these skills, you will not be considered.



- AI video generation. You use AI video tools as a core part of your workflow including Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, Gemini Omni, ElevenLabs, Suno, Seedance 2.5). You understand image-to-video, keyframes and prompting fundamentals. 



- Social-native editing. You understand paid social on TikTok and Instagram: pacing, hooks, native captions, and what makes an ad feel at home in the feed.



- Editing craft. Strong direct editing skills in Premiere Pro, and the discipline to work to deadlines.



- Creativity. You bring ideas and taste to every edit, not just execution.



- Native-level English. You understand a brief first time, and your on-screen text is flawless. Bonus points if you can understand different english accents (American, English, Australian etc)



- Speedy Communication. You are very communicative: fast replies during working hours, active on Slack and WhatsApp every day, with at least 2 hours of overlap with the UK morning (approximately 4:00pm to 6:00pm Philippine Time).

Reliability. You follow briefs, work fast, and deliver on time without being chased.



Desirable

- Experience editing paid social ads for e-commerce or DTC brands.

- An understanding of the paid advertising concepts

- Problem solving skills



What We Offer



- Per-video pay with no ceiling:

You are paid per approved video, not per hour. The more quality work you deliver, the more you earn, and there is no cap. Fast turnarounds on approved work earn bonuses on top.

Strong performers can receive several videos per week and priority on new briefs with potential to earn $1000+ per week



- Well-known brands:

Your ads will run on some globally recognised brand channels



- Genuinely Creative work:

This is a truly creative role where you will use the best AI video models in the industry, at the frontier of where advertising is going. If you love this technology, and want to work in a frontier sector, this is a role where you get paid to be great at it.



- Opportunity to grow. We are scaling, and the editors who prove themselves get more volume, higher-value productions and a bigger roles, responsibility and earning potential as we expand.



- Assistance along the way. Scripts, briefs, reference videos, art direction and structured feedback are all supplied on every job. You focus on the edit.



How to Apply

Answer these four questions and provide the requested links below:



1. Which AI tools, models and platforms do you use regularly?

2. Which tools or models do you prefer for A-roll (people talking to camera) versus B-roll (products, environments, action), and why?

3. How would you create a highly realistic human avatar with AI? Which models currently give the most human-like results?

4. What is the most common giveaway that a shot is AI-generated, and how do you fix it in your own work?



Please also provide at least two or three links to past work, including paid social ads you have produced. Links must open without login or access requirements

title: Compliance Officer (AI and Data), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained. 



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise clients. They need to know their data is safe and that our products meet European rules, so we are hiring someone whose full focus is compliance.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You make sure every product we ship is compliant and properly documented. You report to our Head of Operations and work closely with our Head of Technology and Head of Product.



- Compliance documentation: keep it current for every product and client project, including data flows, processing records, security measures and risk assessments

- Client agreements: prepare data processing agreements and answer client security questionnaires

- Regulation checks: check products against GDPR and the EU AI Act, and flag gaps early to the product owner

- Internal policies: maintain our policies on data retention, access management and i
 response, and make sure teams follow them

- AI model register: track which AI models and hosting locations each product uses, so we can answer client questions fast

- Audits: support audits and certification work, such as ISO 27001



We are an AI company, and we want someone who helps our clients use AI safely and with confidence. That doesn't mean saying yes to everything. Sometimes good advice is "yes, and here's how." Sometimes it's "not like this." We value both, and we want you to speak up when something is at risk.





What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of experience in compliance, data privacy, IT audit or information security

- Hands-on experience with GDPR, such as DPIAs, processing records or data processing agreements

- You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work, and can show us how

- A precise, structured way of working

- Excellent English communication, especially written

- Comfortable asking developers the right questions and turning technical answers into clear documentation





Nice-to-have:

- Hands-on experience with Claude and how it handles data, connectors and Anthropic's terms. This will make your application stand out.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act

- A certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar

- Experience at a software or SaaS company

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and how AI models are hosted

- Experience working with European clients



If you already know Claude well, that's a big advantage. If you don't, we will teach you. We are an Anthropic partner and work with Claude every day, so you'll learn how Claude handles data, how connectors work and what Anthropic's terms say. What we need from you first is a solid compliance foundation and real curiosity about the tools.



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to draft policies, compare regulations or prepare questionnaire answers, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the compliance function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real questions: work where AI, privacy and regulation meet

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the compliance function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your CV / resume

2. Optional: certifications, LinkedIn profile, or examples of policies or documentation you wrote (anonymized). 



 subject: "Compliance Officer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your application within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates get a short practical assignment

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like bringing structure where there is none yet

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and how regulation shapes it



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Have no hands-on experience with GDPR or information security

We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Amazon DSP Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale Amazon DSP advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts, with additional experience in Amazon PPC advertising.



This is a client-facing role. The ideal candidate can present performance updates, explain advertising strategies, answer client questions, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations. The primary focus is DSP strategy, audience targeting, optimization, and performance analysis, while PPC knowledge supports integrated advertising plans. The specialist will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead.



Key Responsibilities

Amazon DSP Campaign Management (Primary Focus)

* Manage and optimize Amazon DSP campaigns across multiple client accounts.

* Develop full-funnel DSP strategies for awareness, acquisition, retargeting, and conversion.

* Build campaigns using first-party audiences, behavioral and contextual targeting, and custom audiences.

* Manage prospecting, remarketing, and competitor conquesting initiatives.

* Optimize budgets, bids, audience segments, frequency caps, placements, and creative performance.

* Analyze campaign, audience, placement, and ASIN-level results; track spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rates, reach, frequency, and attributed sales.

* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), where available, to support audience insights and measurement.

* Audit campaigns, identify wasted spend and incremental growth opportunities, and maintain effective budget pacing.

* Partner with creative teams to assess display, video, and other DSP assets



Amazon PPC Management (Secondary Focus)

* Support Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Apply working knowledge of keywords, product targeting, match types, bids, and placements.

* Review ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, and conversion performance.

* Coordinate DSP and PPC strategies to support overall sales and advertising efficiency.



Performance Analysis & Strategic Growth

* Identify trends, inefficiencies, growth opportunities, and potential root causes of performance changes.

* Consider organic sales, product rankings, pricing, inventory, and conversion rates when making recommendations.

* Develop and execute structured tests of audiences, creatives, placements, and campaign formats.

* Evaluate how DSP and PPC contribute together to broader Amazon advertising goals.



Client Communication & Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: ScreenFlow Video Editor (Mac user only)
description:
We record training videos for online courses. We need someone to tidy them up and add slides, in ScreenFlow, which only runs on MAC OS. It does not run on a PC.



1. This role pays $3 per hour.

2. Roughly 20 hrs/week.

3. You can only do this work if you have a MAC with Screenflow installed. 

***DO NOT apply if you don't have a MAC.



THE WORK



There are two parts to every video.



First, cut out mistakes. We record in long takes, and when the instructor fumbles a line he stops and says it again. You remove the bad version, keep the good one, and join the cut so it runs smoothly. The finished video should sound like he said it right the first time.



Second, add the slides. Each video comes with the recording, a set of slide images, and a timing file. The timing file gives you the exact sentence where each slide starts and the exact sentence where it ends. There is no guesswork and no decisions for you to make. You place the slides, size my webcam down to a small picture in picture in the corner, and export.



The first job is around 60 videos, sent in batches. After that we carry on producing new videos every month, so there is a steady flow of work from here on. This is a long-term role rather than a one-off project.



REQUIREMENTS: **SCREENFLOW ONLY**.



Not Premiere, not Final Cut, not DaVinci, not CapCut. 



We work in ScreenFlow and need the project files back in Screenflow so we can edit them later. Work done in any other software is no use to us.



YOU MUST USE A MAC. Because ScreenFlow only runs on macOS.

It doesn't run on PC.



English good enough to follow a timing file and to hear where the instructor has repeated a line.

If a video comes back with a mistake, you fix it at no extra charge. We do not pay twice for the same work.



TO APPLY



Start your message with the word ScreenFlow. Then tell us:



How long you have used ScreenFlow

That you accept $3 per hour

A link to something you have edited



Messages that do not start with ScreenFlow will not be read.
