description:
ABOUT US

We're a US-based (Michigan) Amazon wholesale seller. We buy direct from brands

and authorized distributors and sell FBA. We're building out our supplier pipeline and need someone to own the front end of it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build our distributor and brand pipeline inside our sourcing platform (Third-Party Profits) — research, screen, and log complete supplier records

- Send outreach emails to US distributors and brands to open wholesale accounts

- Handle the standard objections ("we don't sell to Amazon sellers," "no e-commerce") and push applications through to approval

- Get line sheets and price lists, load them into the platform, and run scans

- Identify profitable products we're cleared to sell and build purchase orders for the owner to approve

- Track everything daily in the platform and a shared Google Sheet



SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm US Eastern = 9:00pm-5:00am Manila.

This is a night shift. Please only apply if you can commit to it long term.



REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ year as an Amazon VA, wholesale sourcing strongly preferred

- Excellent written English — you'll email US brand reps without me editing it

- Clear spoken English — this role includes phone calls to US distributors

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel: VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, pivot tables, text-to-columns, and you know why a UPC has to be stored as text

- You understand FBA fees: referral, fulfillment by size tier, storage, inbound placement

- Comfortable with Keepa and/or SellerAmp — sales rank, offer count, Buy Box

- You know what a line sheet, case pack, inner pack, MOQ and net-30 are

- Reliable internet plus a backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for calls

- Your own computer and headset



NICE TO HAVE

- You've used Third-Party Profits, SmartScout, or Tactical Arbitrage

- You've personally opened wholesale accounts with US brands or distributors

- Experience getting brands ungated legitimately



PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF

- You offer "ungating services" or guarantee brand approvals

- You sell on Amazon yourself or want to source alongside us

- You'd need our account login rather than a secondary user invite



PAY

Starts with a paid 5-day trial project. Strong performers move to a full-time monthly role with a night-shift premium, semi-monthly pay via Wise or Payoneer, and a 13th-month bonus.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me:

1. The word CASEPACK in your subject line

2. Three sentences: a wholesale account you helped open, and how you found that supplier

3. Two or three sentences answering this — what's the difference between a distributor account and a brand-direct account, and which would you approach first for a new seller, and why?

4. A link to a 2-minute recording of yourself introducing your experience (Loom, Google Drive, anything)

5. Your internet speed and whether you have backup power



Applications missing any of the five won't be reviewed.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

- Familiarity with GTA games and an interest in exploring, testing, and finding interesting footage.

- Reliable internet capable of uploading large video files.

- Good communication and the ability to follow written instructions carefully.



### Required recording settings



All recordings must meet these requirements:



- **1080p or higher resolution.**

- **Saved as MP4 files.**

- **HDR switched off** so the colours do not wash out in editing.

- **Notifications and trophy or achievement pop-ups turned off.**

- **Game sound only:** no microphone, no party chat, and no audio from the room or anything playing in the background.

- **In-game radio switched off unless we specifically request it**, because copyrighted songs can cause claims on our videos.



Deliver the original recordings without added music or commentary.



### To apply



Please include:



1. **A brief description of your previous gameplay recording experience.**

2. **Two or three examples of gameplay you personally recorded**, including an original recording sample so we can assess video and audio quality. Explain your contribution to any published videos you link.

3. **Your gaming platform and capture card model**, plus the resolution and frame rate you normally record at.

4. **Whether you already own GTA 6 or have it preordered.**

5. **Confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week**, along with your available working hours.

6. **Your expected hourly or monthly rate.**



**Applications without examples of previous gameplay recording work will not be considered.**

title: Bail Operations Coordinator | Part-Time, Remote
description:
Bail Connect is a North Carolina bail bond agency looking for a dependable coordinator to run our day-to-day operations. Families often reach out during stressful situations. Your job is to keep calls, check-ins, payments, paperwork, and deadlines moving so families and agents know what happens next. We’ll train you on our systems and procedures.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



• Calls and follow-up. Answer routine calls, take accurate messages, verify factual information through approved sources, and connect callers with the licensed agent on duty. Log each inquiry and follow up until the agent documents the outcome.

• Client check-ins and weekly risk report. Call clients for scheduled check-ins and send approved upcoming court reminders. Record the results and report overdue check-ins, upcoming deadlines, payment discrepancies, missing documents, and expiring powers. Escalate missed court appearances and urgent concerns directly to the licensed agent.

• Payments and records. Track payment schedules, receipts, deposits, and agent remittances. Match payments to the correct bond and refer disputes or requests to change terms to the licensed agent.

• Bond paperwork and filings. Send agent-approved electronic packets, track signatures, and enter verified information in BailBooks. Assemble supporting court records, coordinate submission with the responsible agent, and track filing confirmations. Upload authorized administrative documents to the surety platform.

• Records research and skip-tracing support. Check approved sources for updated contact information at the licensed agent’s direction. Document the source and pass verified information to the agent for follow-up.

• Agent recruitment and coverage. Coordinate recruiting and onboarding, track documentation for review, and keep the licensed primary and backup roster current. Lead a short weekly team meeting and record each follow-up with an owner and due date.



Licensed agents assess cases, quote terms, make bond decisions, and handle regulated paperwork and compliance decisions.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Clear, professional spoken and written English. You communicate calmly with U.S. callers, confirm important details, and give accurate handoffs.

• Experience supporting a U.S.-based business or U.S. customers in administration, dispatch, customer service, recruiting, or operations.

• Reliable attendance, strong attention to detail, and a habit of following through without repeated reminders.

• Ability to learn new software quickly, manage competing deadlines, and handle confidential information with discretion.

• Reliable internet, a clear headset, and a quiet workspace.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



• Administrative days: Monday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., and Tuesday and Wednesday, 2–6 p.m. U.S. Eastern time. The role starts with 12 scheduled hours per week at USD $3/hour during a 30-day pilot.

• Weekend on-call: Bail bonding is a 24/7 service, so the agency maintains coverage outside regular shifts. Your standby commitment is limited to agreed windows on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. During those windows, you’ll be the first contact for English calls and route bond inquiries to the licensed agent on duty. Go Answer handles Spanish calls, overflow, and calls outside your windows.

• Weekend pay: USD $25 per month for standby availability, plus USD $3/hour for recorded time spent answering calls, researching records, or completing follow-up work.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your résumé, numbered answers to the three questions below, and one link to a 60–90 second English audio recording in a single application. Make sure the recording link opens without requesting access.



1. Availability: Can you work all three administrative shifts? List the windows you can reliably cover on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday in U.S. Eastern time and tell us your earliest start date.

2. Attention to detail: Describe a specific time you caught a payment, paperwork, or scheduling error. What did you do, and how did you confirm it was resolved?

3. Weekend judgment: You’re on call Saturday. A family is waiting for a callback, the licensed primary hasn’t responded, and an approved packet is missing a signature. What would you do first, whom would you contact, and what would you log?



Audio exercise: A caller says, “My brother was arrested in Mecklenburg County. I don’t know which jail he’s in. Can you tell me how much it’ll cost to get him out?” Respond as if you’re speaking directly to the caller. Then give the brief handoff you’d leave for the licensed agent, including what you confirmed and what still needs follow-up. Use fictional details.

title: Senior Local SEO Strategist / Website Content Architecture
description:
Hiring: Senior Local SEO Strategist / Website Experience & Content Architecture



Company: Rank & Rent Factory

Work Arrangement: Remote - Philippines-based professionals welcome

Engagement: Freelance / contract; ongoing part-time and project-based opportunities

Compensation: Negotiable based on demonstrated expertise, scope, and experience. Please provide your expected rate and currency.



About the Opportunity

Rank & Rent Factory develops local lead generation websites for U.S. home-service markets, including roofing, concrete, tree services, and other contractor industries.



We're seeking an experienced Senior Local SEO Strategist who combines deep organic local SEO knowledge, website content architecture expertise, and practical customer experience (UX) and conversion judgment.



Your main responsibility is to determine what a website should contain, how its pages and information should be organized, and how those decisions can attract relevant visitors, help customers make informed decisions, and generate qualified inquiries.



You'll collaborate with our Web Asset Production Lead to develop practical website recommendations and implementation requirements. Production changes will be coordinated through the existing team.



This is primarily a strategic role, not a WordPress development, backlink outreach, graphic design, or bulk content-writing position.



Key Responsibilities

Local Organic SEO and Market Research

- Analyze service demand, customer search intent, local competitors, and geographic opportunities.

- Identify commercially relevant keywords, markets, service-page opportunities, and location targets.

- Develop evidence-based strategies for new websites and improvements to existing assets.

- Distinguish organic website SEO performance from Google Maps, Business Profile, and paid advertising results.



Website Content and Information Architecture

- Plan homepage, service-page, location-page, and supporting-content relationships.

- Develop keyword-to-page mappings, site hierarchy, internal linking, and meaningful page differentiation.

- Prepare actionable SEO content briefs covering page purpose, customer questions, required information, and credibility.

- Avoid unnecessary, repetitive, or thin pages created solely to target keyword variations.



Customer Experience (UX) and Conversion

- Consider the customer journey from search result to landing page, clear information, confident decision, and qualified inquiry.

- Evaluate information hierarchy, navigation, readability, mobile usability, visual presentation, and contact pathways.

- Recommend improvements that help customers understand services, assess options, establish trust, and take appropriate action.

- Provide annotated page outlines, simple wireframes, or similar guidance that Production can implement.



Content Quality, Implementation, and Improvement

- Define expectations for accurate, useful, service-specific website content.

- Recommend opportunities to incorporate authentic project evidence, relevant photography, contractor knowledge, and verifiable trust signals.

- Flag missing information and unsupported business claims rather than inventing details.

- Collaborate with Production on implementation, review checkpoints, and SEO/UX tradeoffs.

- Establish clear priorities, assumptions, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

- Evaluate meaningful outcomes such as organic visibility, relevant traffic, qualified inquiries, customer usability, and production effort.

- Contribute evidence-based improvements to RNRF's evolving Ideal Website Architecture Standards (IWAS).



IWAS is a working framework, not a fixed template. We welcome specialists who can constructively challenge existing approaches and recommend practical improvements supported by evidence.



Required Qualifications

- Proven professional experience in organic local SEO, preferably for U.S. home-service businesses or local lead generation websites.

- Strong keyword research, SERP analysis, geographic targeting, on-page SEO, and website architecture skills.

- Demonstrated ability to develop practical site structures, keyword-to-page mappings, content briefs, and implementation requirements.

- Strong understanding of search intent, customer decision-making, UX, information hierarchy, and conversion.

- Familiarity with Google Search Console and professional SEO research tools.

- Ability to communicate strategic reasoning clearly and distinguish observed results from assumptions or untested hypotheses.

- Independent judgment, sound research skills, and constructive collaboration with production teams.

- Experience with rank-and-rent websites, technical SEO, WordPress, conversion research, or repeatable website production systems is valuable but not mandatory.

- We prioritize deep SEO expertise, practical architectural judgment, and customer-focused recommendations. Expert graphic design and coding skills are not required.



Initial Engagement and Opportunities

Our primary goal is to work with one senior strategist for ongoing part-time collaboration.



An initial assignment may focus on one real website or market, with agreed deliverables such as a prioritized diagnosis, proposed sitemap, search-intent mapping, and a detailed priority-page brief incorporating UX and conversion recommendations.



We may also consider additional specialists for independent architecture reviews, alternative proposals, or defined projects when their expertise adds clear value.



There is no predetermined number of engagements. Opportunities depend on demonstrated capability, business needs, availability, implementation capacity, and approved budgets.



How to Apply

Interested applicants should complete the application form below. All application requirements and instructions are provided in the form.



Application Form:


 



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid, time-boxed practical assessment using a defined brief and consistent evaluation criteria.



We look forward to working with specialists who can help us build more useful, credible, and effective local service websites.

title: PLASTERING ESTIMATOR
description:
Plastering, Framing & Suspended Ceiling Estimator / Virtual Estimating Assistant

Remote – Philippines, India| Part-Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Plastering Estimator / Construction Estimator to join a remote estimating team supporting an established Australian construction business.

This is a specialist estimating role covering residential construction and commercial fit-outs, not a general virtual assistant position.

The successful candidate will review Australian architectural drawings, reflected ceiling plans, building plans and specifications and prepare accurate plasterboard, wall and ceiling framing, suspended ceiling and insulation take-offs, scopes of work and quotations for residential and commercial projects.

The role involves working with Australian construction documentation, including architectural plans, elevations, sections, bathroom details and construction specifications.

Australian Construction Experience Is Essential

Applicants must have previous experience working with Australian construction companies, builders or trades.

We are not looking for a general VA who can be trained from scratch.

The successful candidate must already understand:

Australian construction terminology.

Australian residential building plans.

Australian plasterboard and plastering practices.

Australian construction standards and specifications.

BCA/NCC requirements.

Australian builder expectations.

Australian construction pricing and quoting.

Australian measurements and metric dimensions.

Australian trade scopes, inclusions and exclusions.

Experience estimating for Queensland construction projects is highly desirable.

The ability to understand references such as BCA 2022, Australian Standards, wet-area requirements and manufacturer specifications is important when reviewing project documentation.

What You Will Be Doing

The successful candidate will take an Australian construction project and work through the complete estimating process:

Plans → Scope → Quantities → Materials → Labour → Inclusions/Exclusions → Pricing → Quote

Typical items requiring identification and pricing include:

Plasterboard ceilings.

Plasterboard walls.

Wet-area plasterboard.

Villaboard/cement sheet wet-area linings.

Laundry wall linings.

Cornice.

Bulkheads.

Square-set areas.

Niches and ledges.

Ceiling/wall junctions.

Pre-paint preparation.

Different plasterboard types.

Finish levels.

Fixing requirements.

Excluded works.

Additional and optional items.

Key Responsibilities

1. Plan & Drawing Review

Review architectural drawings and construction documentation.

Read floor plans, elevations and sections.

Identify room layouts, wall lengths and ceiling areas.

Identify ceiling heights and changes in ceiling levels.

Review bathroom and wet-area details.

Identify openings, recesses, niches, bulkheads and other features.

Cross-reference drawings to ensure the plastering scope is complete.

2. Plasterboard Take-Offs

Complete accurate quantity take-offs for:

Internal walls.

Ceilings.

Wet areas.

Laundry areas.

Bulkheads.

Feature areas.

Other plasterboard-lined surfaces.

Calculate quantities in appropriate Australian units, including m² and linear metres.

3. Material Identification

Determine the appropriate lining and materials based on drawings and project requirements, including:

Standard plasterboard.

Moisture-resistant plasterboard.

Villaboard/cement sheet.

Ceiling board.

Cornice.

Compounds.

Fixings.

Accessories.

Other plastering materials.

4. Scope of Works

Prepare clear scopes identifying:

Inclusions:

Supply and installation.

Fixing.

Setting.

Cornice.

Finishing.

Pre-paint preparation.

Other specifically included works.

Exclusions:

Items supplied or completed by the builder or other trades.

Scaffolding and access equipment.

Framing/battens where applicable.

Insulation.

FC cladding.

Fire/sound-rated systems unless specified.

Square-set items not included.

Access panels.

Other non-standard works.

The estimator must be able to identify potential exclusions rather than assume everything shown on a plan is included.

5. Australian Standards & Specifications

Review relevant notes within project documentation.

Recognise requirements that affect the plastering scope.

Understand relevant Australian Standards, BCA/NCC references and manufacturer specifications.

Review wet-area requirements and specified lining systems.

Flag missing or unclear information before pricing.

The estimator is not expected to provide engineering or certification advice but must recognise requirements that may affect the scope and cost.

6. Labour & Cost Estimation

Calculate estimated labour requirements.

Apply appropriate Australian labour rates and allowances.

Calculate material costs.

Allow for wastage where appropriate.

Identify additional labour requirements for difficult areas.

Consider access, ceiling height and project complexity.

Apply the company's pricing structure and margins.

7. Quote Preparation

Prepare professional quotations that clearly communicate:

Project details.

Scope of works.

Quantities.

Pricing.

Inclusions and exclusions.

Optional/additional items.

Assumptions.

Quote validity.

GST treatment where applicable.

Practical Assessment Before Appointment

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical estimating assessment using one residential project and one commercial fit-out project.

The assessment will evaluate:

Detailed quantity take-offs.

Material calculations and order preparation.

Labour estimates.

Complete quotation preparation.

Inclusions, exclusions and assumptions.

RFI/clarification lists.

Accuracy, completeness and turnaround time.

Candidates must also demonstrate the ability to:

Prepare material, labour and margin calculations using the provided pricing structure and quotation template.

Identify work above 3 m requiring access arrangements and clarify builder-supplied access equipment.

Avoid double-counting WR plasterboard and Villaboard on the same surface.

Apply an appropriate plasterboard waste allowance, normally 5–7%, subject to approval.

Follow company sheet-layout guidance:

2400 mm = 2 × 1200 mm.

2700 mm = 2 × 1350 mm.

For 2590 mm, assess 1200 + 1350 mm sheet arrangements and required finishing/detail.

Use 6000 mm sheets where practical.

Prepare quantities in m² and linear metres, along with a practical material order listing board dimensions, sheet counts, framing components, insulation, compounds, fixings and accessories.

Additional Scope – Residential & Commercial Fit-Out Estimating

The estimator must be capable of pricing complete internal lining, framing, suspended ceiling and insulation packages for Australian houses, offices, schools, retail premises and other commercial fit-outs.

Wall and Ceiling Framing

Understand Rondo framing and ceiling systems.

Estimate steel and timber wall framing.

Calculate studs, tracks, noggins, head/base details, bracing and specified accessories.

Estimate ceiling battens, furring channels, top cross rails, hangers, clips and suspension systems.

Suspended Ceiling Systems

Interpret reflected ceiling plans, ceiling set-outs, levels, grid layouts and perimeter trims.

Estimate exposed T-grid and acoustic ceiling tile systems.

Estimate concealed suspended ceilings.

Estimate suspended plasterboard ceilings.

Identify bulkheads and access-related details.

Insulation and Performance Systems

Estimate thermal and acoustic wall and ceiling insulation.

Identify insulation batts and specified fire-rated insulation.

Recognise fire-rated and acoustic-rated partitions and ceilings.

Follow documented tested system requirements and flag missing details before pricing.

Commercial Project Requirements

Experience estimating the following is important:

Commercial partition walls.

Office and retail fit-outs.

Schools and educational facilities.

Larger commercial construction packages.

Fire-rated and acoustic-rated systems.

Suspended ceiling systems.

Commercial insulation packages.

Required Experience

Essential

Previous experience as a plastering estimator, drywall estimator or construction estimator.

Direct experience estimating plasterboard, wall and ceiling framing, suspended ceilings and insulation packages.

Experience reading Australian architectural/construction drawings.

Previous experience working with Australian construction companies.

Strong understanding of Australian construction terminology and practices.

Working knowledge of Australian building standards and documentation.

Experience preparing construction quotations.

Strong quantity take-off skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong written and spoken English.

Strong Excel and computer skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Highly Desirable

Previous experience estimating Australian residential new builds.

Previous experience with Brisbane or Queensland builders.

Experience with renovations and commercial fit-outs.

Experience estimating plasterboard supply and installation.

Experience with wet-area linings and Villaboard.

Experience pricing cornice, square-set and bulkhead works.

Experience with Australian construction estimating/take-off software such as Bluebeam, PlanSwift or CostX.

Experience working directly with Australian builders and subcontractors.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can review a set of Australian construction plans and understand the plastering job without needing everything explained to them.

You should be able to identify:

What needs to be lined → What material is required → How much is required → How it needs to be finished → What labour is involved → What should be included/excluded → What the job should be priced at.

You should also be comfortable identifying discrepancies or missing information and raising questions before the quotation is submitted.

Working Hours

Working schedule will be arranged to provide suitable overlap with the Australian team.

Potential to increase working hours as workload grows and the candidate demonstrates consistent performance.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

Accuracy of estimates.

Accuracy of material quantities.

Quote turnaround time.

Accuracy of labour allowances.

Quality of scopes.

Correct identification of inclusions and exclusions.

Ability to identify missing information.

Reliability and communication.

Ability to work with minimal supervision.

Application Requirements

Years of plastering/construction estimating experience.

Details of your Australian construction experience.

Names/types of Australian companies or builders you have worked with.

Types of projects you have estimated.

Your availability for approximately 4 hours per day.

Expected hourly rate.

Candidates will be asked about their experience with Australian plans and estimating.

Applicants should understand that the sample plans and plastering quotation provided represent the general standard and type of work expected in this role.

The estimator will be expected to review similar Australian construction documentation and produce an accurate, detailed and commercially usable plastering scope and estimate.

title: Part-time Social Media & Admin Assistant (Music Marketing), 15 hrs/week, $650/month
description:
15 hrs/week · $650 a month · UK agency · long-term · starting Monday 12 January



Who we are



A small UK-based marketing agency working with independent music artists. We run their social media, their releases and their campaigns. The team is a handful of specialists, so what you make goes out, and you see how it lands.



What you would do



Our clients' accounts

• Run our clients' fan pages and accounts: posting, scheduling, keeping them active

• Find the content to post on them, not just publish what you are handed

• Reply to comments and DMs on them

• Everything that goes out to a client's audience is approved first. You will never be guessing



Our own social media

• Plan and schedule our posts

• Write captions in our voice

• Make the graphics and carousels in Canva

• Bring us content ideas, not just execute ours



The founder's calls and calendar

• Schedule her 1:1 calls

• Send the notes and the recording after each one

• Keep her calendar straight



Client onboarding, on a schedule

• Send the onboarding form as soon as a client says yes, and chase it on day 3 and day 7

• Build the pre-work week schedule before a start date

• Send the kick-off invite, set up the client group, send the welcome doc at the kick-off



Keeping things organised

• Client folders and content on our Drive, named so anyone can find them

• Collect the numbers for our monthly client reports, on the same day each month

• Keep our prospect list current, with a source on every line



Website and documents

• Change text and swap photos on our website, following step-by-step guides with screenshots

• Draft sections of our case studies from a bullet-point doc



What we are looking for



• You design well in Canva. Not a template filler

• You have run social media before, ideally for music or entertainment, and understand what works

• You understand music, and you can tell good artist content from filler

• You are highly organised and proactive, and things get done without being chased

• You care about the quality of your own work

• Your written English is good enough for a client
, and you are comfortable on a call

• You can follow a written guide on your own and not need the first step explained twice

• You work with Claude every day, and you check what it gives you

• Claude Code: you have used it, or you can get up to speed on it in your first weeks

• Notion, Google Drive and Sheets, and basic WordPress edits

• You have your own computer, reliable internet, and a plan for power cuts



A plus, not essential: short-form video editing in CapCut ·
 newsletters · a scheduling tool like Meta Business Suite or Later



How you work, which matters as much as the skills



• You ask when a brief is unclear instead of guessing

• You say early when something will be late, or has gone wrong

• You answer messages the same working day

• You are discreet: unreleased music and client information stay private

• You take feedback without taking it personally

• You check your own work: names, dates, numbers, links

• You are curious and you want to learn. The tools here change often and we like that

• You are friendly and reliable. We are a small team and it matters



On AI



We run on Claude, every day, and some of our work runs through Claude Code. We want someone who works the same way, with judgement: you draft with it, you check it, you can tell when it has invented something, and you know what must never be pasted into it. You do not have to arrive an expert on Claude Code. You do have to want to learn it, and be honest about what you checked.



Hours and pay



• 15 hours a week, 3 hours a day, Monday to Friday

• Your hours sit inside 4pm to 8pm Manila time (8am to 12pm UK), so we overlap every day

• $650 a month, which is $10 an hour

• The contract is in sterling, £500, and we pay by Wise straight to your Philippine account in pesos. One conversion, and you do not need a dollar account. The dollar figure moves a little with the exchange rate, and we review it once a year

• Busier weeks around a release occasionally need a few hours more. Those are agreed with you in advance and paid at the same rate

• Starting Monday 12 January. This is a long-term part-time role, not a project. We are looking for someone who stays



You report to the founder, and sometimes to our senior social lead.



One thing we will never ask you to do: touch our bank, our invoices or anything to do with money. That stays with the founder.



How to apply



Four things. Applications without them will not be read:



1. A video of 3 to 4 minutes (Loom, an unlisted YouTube link or Google Drive). Cover four things: who you are and why this role, one thing you have made shown on screen and why you made the choices you did, how you use Claude in your work, and one time you stopped trusting what it gave you. Don't over-produce it. We care what you say, not the edit

2. Your portfolio, or three examples of social content you made yourself. Say which platform and which account

3. Pick an artist you like. Tell us one thing you would change about their Instagram, and why

4. Three to five lines on the part-time role you held the longest, and why you stayed



To apply: (1) apply on OnlineJobs.ph, then (2) fill in this form, which takes about ten minutes: 



Applications without the form will not be read. Please apply by 24 November 2026.

title: Appointment Setter WITH BONUSES
description:
Virtual Assistant — Outbound Caller & Appointment Setter

Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time | Life Insurance



About the Role:

8AM-3PM CT or 3PM-9PM CT



We are a fast-growing life insurance agency based in Illinois looking for a driven, fluent English-speaking VA to join our team. Your job is straightforward — call people who already have life insurance, introduce them to a better option, and either book them for a review call with our agent or transfer them live.



Every person you dial already has an existing life insurance policy. You are not selling from scratch. You are having a simple conversation: their current policy costs more and offers less — we can switch them to a better carrier with lower premiums and added benefits. Your job is to get them on the phone with our agent so they can see that for themselves.

This is a warm outbound role. No cold prospecting. No selling. Just real conversations that lead to appointments and transfers.



Schedule

8:00 AM – 3:00 PM CST (Central Standard Time) OR 3:00PM - 9:00PM CST (Central Standard Time), Monday through Friday. We are flexible with hours as long as you hit KPI's. You must be logged in and actively dialing during the hours. CST is night shift Philippines time — please confirm you can fully commit to this schedule before applying. Every morning starts with a team training session before dialing begins.



What You'll Do 



- Call warm leads using our GoHighLevel power dialer — these people already have life insurance and are open to reviewing their options

- Follow our proven script to introduce the consolidation opportunity and book a review appointment or transfer live

- Warm transfer hot leads directly to our agent when they are ready to talk immediately

- Log every call with accurate notes and dispositions in GoHighLevel immediately after every call

- Drop pre-recorded voi
s on no-answers with one click

- Send confirmation texts to booked leads directly from GoHighLevel

- Hit a minimum of 150 dials per day

- Attend the daily morning training session — this is mandatory, not optional

- Submit your end-of-day report every day by 5PM CST: dials, contacts, appointments booked, live transfers sent





Systems We Use



- GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, power dialer, calendar, and messaging. You will live in this system all day

- WhatsApp — team communication, morning check-ins, and daily accountability

- Google Sheets — end-of-day report tracking



Full training provided on all systems before your first live dial day.



Requirements



- Fluent, neutral-accent English — non-negotiable. You will speak to Americans all day every day

- Prior outbound calling experience — insurance, appointment setting, BPO, or call center background on US campaigns required

- Experience in insurance specifically is a strong advantage — life insurance, health insurance, final expense, or any related product

- Minimum 25 Mbps internet, wired connection strongly preferred

- Own laptop or desktop — no tablets, no Chromebooks

- Quiet, dedicated home office — zero background noise

- Fully available and committed to CST business hours including Saturdays

- Coachable, consistent, and resilient — you will hear no regularly and it cannot affect your energy





Compensation



- Base: $100 a week + $25 per close. (YOU WILL AVERAGE 7 CLOSES A WEEK FROM US) 

- Performance bonus: $25 per tracked sale — every time a lead you booked or transferred results in a closed policy, you earn $25. All sales have to be tracked in GoHighLevel so everything is transparent.

- Weekly streak bonus: $50 extra if you hit 5+ tracked sales in a single week

- Monthly bonuses 

- Paid bi-weekly

- 30-day performance review — strong performers receive a base pay increase and first access to expanded hours and responsibilities





To Apply

- Record a 1–2 minute voice memo introducing yourself and walking us through your outbound calling experience. Tell us what campaigns you worked, your average daily dial volume, and why you are the right fit for this role.

- Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. No exceptions.

- Include your resume and your available start date. We are hiring immediately — qualified candidates hear back within 48 hours.

- Identify problems, missing information, and delayed projects.

### 2. Sales & Estimate Follow-Up



**We want someone who can do more than answer questions. We want someone who can help us earn business.**

- Call homeowners who have received roofing estimates.

- Follow up with leads who haven't scheduled inspections.

- Build trust and address customer questions and objections.

- Identify opportunities for additional services.

- Keep sales opportunities organized and moving forward.



Previous experience in sales, customer retention, appointment setting, or estimate follow-up is highly preferred.



You should be comfortable asking customers for their business.



### 3. Cold Calling & Business Development



You will help us develop relationships with businesses and professionals who can refer roofing opportunities.



Responsibilities include:



- Make outbound calls to potential referral partners.

- Contact property managers, real estate agents, insurance agents, contractors, and other businesses.

- Research potential customers and referral sources.

- Build and maintain prospect lists.

- Schedule meetings and appointments.

- Send personalized follow-up
s and text messages.

- Conduct LinkedIn outreach.

- Track conversations, follow-ups, and opportunities in our CRM.

- Help generate new roofing leads and business relationships.



**You must be comfortable making outbound calls to people you've never met.**



Previous cold-calling or business development experience is strongly preferred.



### 4. Marketing, AI & Technology



You may also assist with:



- LinkedIn and social media management.

-
 and SMS marketing campaigns.

- Creating Canva graphics and marketing materials.

- AI-assisted content creation.

- CRM management and automation.

- Customer reactivation campaigns.

- Lead research and prospecting.

- Improving workflows and business processes.

- Using AI tools to work more efficiently.



Experience with these tools is valuable:



- GoHighLevel

- JobNimbus

- QuickBooks

- Dialpad

- ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini

- Canva

- LinkedIn

- Google Workspace

- 

- Other CRM or project-management software



You don't need to know every platform.



**We value someone who is technologically capable, learns quickly, and can figure things out independently.**



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Our ideal candidate is:



- An exceptional English communicator.

- Extremely confident and personable on the phone.

- Experienced in customer service and outbound calling.

- Comfortable discussing services and helping close sales.

- Smart, quick-thinking, and resourceful.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Proactive and able to work without constant supervision.

- Comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities.

- Excellent at following up and completing tasks.

- Technologically capable and eager to learn.

- Reliable, honest, and accountable.

- Comfortable receiving feedback and improving.

- Interested in a stable, long-term position.



**We especially value candidates who have previously worked for U.S.-based roofing, construction, restoration, HVAC, plumbing, property management, or other home-service companies.**



Previous experience as an Operations Coordinator, Office Manager, Customer Service Manager, Sales Coordinator, Project Coordinator, or similar role is a significant advantage.



However, exceptional communication skills, initiative, and the ability to learn are more important than direct roofing experience.



## SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



- Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week.

- Monday through Friday.

- Must be available during Arizona business hours.

- Fully remote position.

- $4-$6 USD per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.

- Long-term opportunity with room to develop additional responsibilities.



We want someone who is interested in becoming a valuable member of our team for years to come.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**IMPORTANT: We review spoken English communication before anything else.**



Please complete the following application requirements.



## STEP 1: RECORD YOUR INTRODUCTION VIDEO



**This is mandatory and is the first part of our screening process.**



Record a 3-4 minute video answering the questions below.



Your video must:

- Be unscripted, without reading prepared answers.

- Include clear audio so we can evaluate your spoken English.

- Be recorded in English.

- Be submitted as a video file or accessible video link.



### Answer these questions:



**1. Tell us about yourself.**

**2. Tell us about your experience.**

**3. Tell us why you're a great fit.**

**4. Customer sales scenario.**

The customer says:

Respond naturally as if you're speaking directly to that customer.



We want to hear how you think, communicate, build trust, and handle objections. You do not need roofing expertise to answer this question.



**We will evaluate your English fluency, pronunciation, clarity, confidence, personality, and ability to think on your feet.**



Only applicants who meet our communication standards will advance.



## STEP 2: SUBMIT YOUR RESUME



Attach your current resume, including your previous employers, job titles, dates of employment, and relevant responsibilities.



## STEP 3: ANSWER THESE 8 QUESTIONS



**1.** Where do you currently live, what hourly rate are you requesting, and can you work 40 hours per week during Arizona business hours?



**2.** Describe your experience communicating with American customers by phone. What types of calls did you handle, and approximately how many calls did you manage daily?



**3.** What experience do you have with sales, cold calling, appointment setting, or following up on estimates? Give specific examples of results you've achieved.



**4.** Have you worked for a U.S.-based roofing, restoration, construction, HVAC, plumbing, or other home-service company? If so, describe the company, your position, and your responsibilities.



**5.** What experience do you have preparing estimates, sending invoices, collecting payments, scheduling projects, or managing customer records?



**6.** Which CRM systems, business software, and AI tools have you used? Provide two specific examples of how you used technology to improve efficiency or results.



**7.** What experience do you have with LinkedIn, social media,
 marketing, SMS campaigns, Canva, or business development?



**8.** Tell us about a time you independently identified a problem and solved it without being asked. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?



## STEP 4: WORKSPACE & INTERNET



Please provide:



- A current photo of your normal workspace.

- A screenshot of your internet speed test showing download speed, upload speed, and ping.

- A brief explanation of your backup internet plan.



## IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Begin your application message with:



**ROOFING OPERATIONS VA**



Your application must include:

- Your resume.

- Answers to all 8 questions.

- Workspace photo.

- Internet speed test.

- Desired hourly rate.



**Applications without the required video will not be considered.**



Candidates who pass the first round may be invited to complete a skills assessment and live video interview.



---



## WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?



We're an established Arizona company with an ambitious vision for growth.

If you're an outstanding English communicator who loves customer service, sales, organization, technology, and helping businesses grow, **we want to hear from you.**

description:

Because you will be helping us scale an already-proven $8M/year operation, your monthly bonus is tied directly to total sales volume across all three divisions. If you know how to coach reps through residential kitchen-table objections, navigate commercial solar decision-makers, and keep sales and operations tightly aligned from contract to install, this role was built for you.



---



🎯 **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**



* Partner with the CEO, Operations & Sales: Work directly with executive leadership, operations, and our US and PH sales teams to build out this new remote leadership seat and ensure seamless alignment from initial pitch to final installation.

* Drive Multi-Company Revenue: Lead the charge across all three divisions—B2C (Residential Solar & Residential Roofing) and B2B (Commercial Solar)—ensuring reps know how to bundle and cross-sell roofing + solar deals to maximize volume.

* Coach & Elevate Talent: Run high-energy daily huddles, call reviews, and 1-on-1 coaching sessions to sharpen setter and closer performance from initial pitch to final contract.

* Own the Numbers & Handoffs: Track and optimize core KPIs—dial-to-contact rates, appointment sit rates, pitch-to-close ratios, and pull-through rates (partnering closely with operations to move signed contracts cleanly to installation).

* Refine the Playbook: Audit our CRM pipelines, eliminate bottlenecks between setters, closers, and project operations, and continuously upgrade scripts and rebuttals for both residential homeowners and commercial property owners.

* Build a Winning Culture: Foster a high-accountability, zero-excuse, results-driven remote sales floor where top performers are recognized and underperformers are coached up or out.



---



✅ **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (MUST-HAVES):**



* 5+ Years of Sales Management Experience: A verifiable track record of building, scaling, and managing remote B2C and B2B sales teams.

* Direct Industry Expertise: Hands-on experience in Residential Solar, Commercial Solar, and/or Residential Roofing is required. You must already understand the terminology, financing/PPA structures, roofing scopes, and buyer psychology of these markets.

* Cross-Department & Cross-Border Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and bridge the gap between PH-based appointment setters/inside sales reps, US-based closers, and internal operations teams.

* Data-Driven Operator: Strong command of CRM pipeline management, conversion metrics, and structured performance turnarounds.

* Remote Self-Starter: Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable stepping into a newly created role where you can help shape the structure while aligning with US business hours.



---



💰 **COMPENSATION & PERKS:**



* Base Pay: $10.00/hour (Full-Time, 40 hrs/week)

* Monthly Sales Volume Bonus: Paid monthly based on total sales volume across all three companies/divisions. As this is a newly created remote role, exact tier structures will be finalized with the right candidate, with On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $10.00/hr base + $800 to $2,700/month in sales bonuses.

* Work Setup: 100% Work-From-Home

* Stability & Scale: Step into a leadership seat at a 15-year-old established organization already installing ~$8M annually, where your strategies will directly grow the bottom line—and your paycheck.



# ==================================================

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**



To be considered for an immediate interview with our CEO, first identify your **Priority Tier** based on your hands-on industry background:



* **TIER 1:** Commercial Solar + Residential Solar + Roofing Sales Managment Experience

* **TIER 2:** Residential Solar OR Commercial Solar  Sales Managment Experience (with or without Roofing)

* **TIER 3:** Roofing  Sales Managment Experience Only

*(Example: TIER 1 – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – 25 Reps – Comm Solar, Resi Solar & Roofing)*

In the body of your message, include 2–3 sentences sharing the biggest monthly or annual revenue volume a team achieved under your leadership.

title: AI Video Creator for Ecommerce Ads | Photorealistic UGC & Creative Hooks
description:
We’re looking for a creative AI video specialist to produce advertising assets for two large, established ecommerce brands.



We take realism extremely seriously. Our standard is footage that looks indistinguishable from real life: believable people, natural movement, convincing environments, and accurate product interactions.



We already have a dedicated AI image generation team and work with detailed reference files and elaborate generation workflows. Now we’re looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with the creativity to turn ideas into attention-grabbing video assets.



What you’ll do



You’ll work alongside our AI image team and video editors, creating assets our video team can turn into finished ads. This includes:



Developing unexpected, scroll-stopping hooks and original visual concepts.



Generating realistic UGC-style clips, customer scenarios, and product demonstrations.



Performing character and location swaps using existing UGC or footage we create in-house.



Reviewing successful ads and concepts, then finding creative ways to turn them into new video executions.



Producing variations of promising ideas while maintaining visual quality and consistency.



Bringing your own ideas and helping us explore what’s possible with AI video.



Some concepts will feel like everyday customer footage. Others will be outrageous, surprising, or funny. Either way, the execution needs to look convincingly filmed.



The challenge: getting the product right



Our products build on familiar everyday items but have specific design innovations. AI often defaults to the generic version, losing the details that make our products different.



You’ll need to preserve those details across shots, movement, and interactions. Product shape, construction, proportions, packaging, and how someone uses the product all matter.



We’re actively building and refining detailed reference libraries covering our products, packaging, models, and locations. You should be comfortable working closely with these references and iterating until both the realism and product accuracy are right.



Who we’re looking for



A strong portfolio of highly realistic AI-generated video.



Experience creating content for ecommerce brands and paid social advertising.



A good understanding of hooks, direct-response creative, and visual storytelling.



Strong judgment about what makes footage look real, including faces, hands, movement, lighting, and physical interactions.



Experience with reference-driven generation and maintaining consistency across clips.



The creativity to contribute concepts and the attention to detail to execute them well.



Experience with Magnific and advanced node-based workflows is a big plus. Character swaps, location swaps, and accurate generation of distinctive products are also especially relevant.



How to apply



Your application must include both a portfolio and an introduction video.



1. Your best work



Send three to five examples of your strongest, most realistic AI video work, preferably recent and relevant to ecommerce. Choose work you’re genuinely proud to share and that demonstrates the highest quality you can deliver.



We’ll assess your ability based on the work you submit. Please don’t send examples with caveats like “this isn’t very good” or “I could do much better.” Your portfolio needs to demonstrate that you can meet our quality standard to be considered.



For each example, briefly explain your contribution and the tools or workflows you used. Also describe how you approach keeping a distinctive product accurate when AI keeps generating a generic version.



2. A short introduction video



Introduce yourself, tell us about your relevant experience, and explain why you would be a strong fit for this role. We want to hear how you combine technical generation skills, creative thinking, and an understanding of ecommerce advertising.



Applications without an introduction video will be disqualified immediately.



We’re looking for someone who can help us push creative ideas further while holding every asset to an exceptionally high standard of realism.

title: Finance & Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT EVORETRO



EVORETRO is an international e-commerce business specializing in collectible accessories and products, including trading card protection, graded card accessories, binders, and other collectibles.



We sell through various online marketplaces and distribution channels, including Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other e-commerce platforms.



As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented E-Commerce Finance & Data Analyst to help manage our financial data, perform reconciliations, analyze business performance, and provide actionable financial insights to management.



This role combines financial analysis, e-commerce reconciliation, inventory cost analysis, and financial reporting.



We welcome applicants with backgrounds in Accountancy, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or related fields. A CPA license is not required.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. E-Commerce Financial Reconciliation

- Reconcile sales transactions across Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other sales channels.

- Match marketplace sales reports against payment processor settlements and actual bank deposits.

- Review marketplace commissions, transaction fees, refunds, chargebacks, and other deductions.

- Investigate discrepancies, missing transactions, duplicate entries, and incorrect payouts.

- Monitor outstanding marketplace settlements and payment transactions.

- Reconcile payment processor transactions, including PayPal, Stripe, and other payment platforms.

- Maintain accurate and organized reconciliation records.



2. Financial Data Analysis

- Analyze sales revenue, expenses, profitability, and business performance.

- Consolidate financial data from multiple e-commerce platforms.

- Analyze gross profit, net profit, product margins, and operating expenses.

- Identify trends, irregularities, and opportunities for cost optimization.

- Analyze marketplace fees, shipping expenses, fulfillment costs, and other operational expenses.

- Assist with financial forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning.

- Provide management with data-driven recommendations.



3. Inventory and Cost Analysis

- Analyze product costs, inventory valuation, and cost of goods sold (COGS).

- Review landed costs, shipping expenses, and other product-related costs.

- Analyze product-level profitability across different sales channels.

- Identify slow-moving and fast-moving inventory from a financial perspective.

- Monitor products with low profit margins or unusually high operational costs.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain and Operations to validate inventory and cost information.



4. Financial Reporting and Dashboard Management

- Prepare weekly and monthly financial performance reports.

- Develop financial dashboards using Excel, Google Sheets, or other reporting tools.

- Consolidate financial information from multiple marketplaces and payment platforms.

- Monitor key performance indicators, including:

  - Total Revenue

  - Net Sales

  - Gross Profit and Gross Margin

  - Net Profit

  - Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)

  - Marketplace Fees

  - Refunds and Chargebacks

  - Inventory Costs

  - Operating Expenses

  - Cash Flow

- Present financial findings and recommendations to management.



5. Process Improvement

- Improve existing financial tracking and reconciliation processes.

- Develop standardized financial reporting templates.

- Identify opportunities to automate financial data consolidation and reporting.

- Maintain consistency and accuracy across financial records.

- Coordinate with Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and Operations teams to validate financial information.



QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS



- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

- At least 2–3 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliation, or e-commerce finance.

- Strong understanding of financial reconciliation and transaction matching.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience preparing financial reports and analyzing business performance.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.



CPA LICENSE IS NOT REQUIRED.



Candidates with strong practical experience in financial analysis, reconciliation, accounting, and data analytics are encouraged to apply.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:



- Experience working with e-commerce or online retail businesses.

- Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, eBay, and Walmart Seller Center.

- Experience reconciling PayPal, Stripe, and other payment processor transactions.

- Knowledge of QuickBooks, Xero, or similar accounting software.

- Understanding of inventory costing, COGS, landed costs, and product profitability.

- Experience with Power BI, SQL, or other business intelligence tools.

- Familiarity with inventory management systems such as Cin7 is an advantage.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote work arrangement.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Paid time off, subject to company eligibility and policies.

- Selected paid Philippine holidays.

- SSS and PhilHealth contribution reimbursement, subject to company eligibility and policies.

- Opportunity to work with an international e-commerce business.

- Opportunity to contribute directly to business performance and financial decision-making.



HOW TO APPLY



Interested applicants should submit their updated resume highlighting their experience in:



1. Financial reconciliation and transaction matching.

2. E-commerce financial analysis and reporting.

3. Marketplace and payment processor reconciliation.

4. Excel, Google Sheets, and other financial tools.

5. Inventory costing, COGS, and profitability analysis.



Please include relevant examples of financial reporting, reconciliation, or analytical projects you have handled, with confidential information removed.



Join EVORETRO and help us turn financial data into better business decisions!

title: Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor
description:
Hiring: Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor



Company: Rank & Rent Factory

Work Arrangement: Remote - Philippines-based professionals welcome

Engagement: Freelance / contract; ongoing part-time and project-based opportunities

Compensation: Negotiable based on demonstrated expertise, scope, and experience. Please provide your expected rate and currency.



About the Opportunity

Rank & Rent Factory develops local lead generation websites for U.S. home-service markets, including roofing, concrete, tree services, and other contractor industries.



We're looking for experienced professionals who can create or independently review original, accurate, SEO-focused website content that helps potential customers understand services, build trust, and make informed decisions.



Our primary opportunity is a Senior SEO Content Writer / Editor responsible for independent research, original writing, substantive self-editing, and delivering high-quality commercial website content.



We may also engage qualified professionals for independent editorial review, specialist writing, backup assignments, and defined content-improvement projects.



Applicants may apply for SEO Content Writing, Independent SEO Content Editing / Review, or both. Writing and independent reviewing capabilities will be evaluated separately.



Our focus is homepages, service pages, location pages, and supporting customer information, not primarily blog writing or mass-produced AI content.



Role 1 - Senior SEO Content Writer

Research and Original Content Creation

- Independently research unfamiliar home-service industries, technical subjects, customer concerns, and relevant terminology using credible sources.

- Develop original, accurate, and useful commercial website content based on approved SEO briefs.

- Explain services clearly in language appropriate for U.S. homeowners and potential customers.

- Write engaging headlines, helpful introductions, substantive service explanations, FAQs, and appropriate calls to action.

- Follow search intent and SEO requirements while integrating relevant keywords naturally and avoiding repetitive, generic content.



Customer Experience (UX) and Conversion

- Organize information for clarity, logical flow, readability, and easy scanning.

- Anticipate customer questions, concerns, and decision-making needs.

- Help visitors understand services, compare relevant options, recognize credible information, and confidently take the next step.

- Recommend useful supporting elements such as comparisons, tables, captions, visuals, or project evidence when appropriate.

- Support qualified inquiries through clear, accurate, customer-focused messaging rather than exaggerated claims.



Accuracy, Substantive Self-Editing, and Delivery

- Fact-check important information, document reliable sources, and identify unresolved questions.

- Distinguish general industry information from business-specific claims requiring authorized confirmation.

- Substantively self-edit for accuracy, originality, clarity, usefulness, structure, SEO alignment, and customer experience.

- Deliver clean, production-ready copy with relevant source notes, metadata or internal-link suggestions where requested, and clearly flagged information gaps.

- Respond constructively to independent editorial feedback and resolve required corrections.



Role 2 - Independent SEO Content Editor / Reviewer

We also welcome experienced professionals who can independently assess SEO website content written by others.



This role requires strong SEO content knowledge, research ability, customer experience judgment, and substantive editorial skills, not proofreading alone.



Responsibilities include:

- Review website content against approved SEO briefs, search intent, and customer needs.

- Evaluate keyword integration, page structure, headings, information hierarchy, readability, and content usefulness.

- Identify unanswered customer questions, confusing explanations, weak messaging, unnecessary repetition, and conversion barriers.

- Verify important factual claims and flag inaccuracies, unsupported statements, or misleading business information.

- Evaluate whether content establishes credibility, supports customer decisions, and provides an appropriate next step.

- Provide clear, evidence-based editorial findings and recommended corrections.

- Distinguish required corrections from useful improvements and personal stylistic preferences.

- Identify issues requiring additional research, SEO strategist input, or authorized subject-matter verification.

- Determine whether content meets editorial requirements, needs further corrections, or should be held pending verification.

- Independent editorial review is separate from content writing.



Requirements for Both Opportunities

- Strong understanding of SEO-focused commercial website content, including local SEO, search intent, content hierarchy, and natural keyword integration.

- Professional experience with website content writing or substantive editing, preferably for U.S. home-service businesses or local lead generation websites.

- Excellent written English, clarity, organization, and customer-focused communication.

- Strong independent research, fact-checking, and critical-thinking skills.

- Ability to understand unfamiliar services and explain or evaluate technical information accurately.

- Practical understanding of content-level UX, customer decision-making, trust, readability, and conversion.

- Ability to recognize weak, generic, inaccurate, misleading, or unhelpful content.

- Strong professional judgment, reliability, and constructive collaboration.

- Writing applicants must demonstrate original research-based writing and substantive self-editing.

- Editorial applicants must demonstrate independent content evaluation, factual verification, and meaningful editorial improvements.

- Experience with rank-and-rent websites, technical service writing, conversion copy, or project case studies is valuable but not mandatory.



Working With Our Team

Our SEO / Website Experience Strategist leads page strategy, search intent, architecture, and strategic requirements.



The SEO Content Writer researches, writes, and self-edits content while contributing professional recommendations and raising concerns about weak briefs or missing information.



An Independent SEO Content Reviewer evaluates content against approved requirements before publication.



Our Web Asset Production Lead coordinates assignments, handoffs, implementation, and publication requirements.



Significant changes to approved content strategy are discussed rather than introduced without agreement.



Writing and editorial contributors may also help improve RNRF's evolving Ideal Website Architecture Standards (IWAS) through practical lessons about content quality, credibility, customer experience, and editorial consistency.



Engagement Opportunities

We are primarily seeking one senior content creator for ongoing part-time collaboration.



Additional project-based opportunities may include:

- Independent SEO content editing and editorial quality review.

- Specialist or backup content writing.

- Defined content improvement and research assignments.

- Approved content or editorial experiments where appropriate.



There is no predetermined number of engagements. Work depends on demonstrated capability, production needs, availability, and approved budgets.



How to Apply

Interested applicants should complete the application form below. All application requirements and instructions are provided in the form.



Application Form:


 



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid, time-boxed practical assessment tailored to the work under consideration.



We look forward to working with professionals who can help us produce useful, accurate, persuasive, and trustworthy websites.

title: Video Content Reviewer and Team Lead (YouTube)
description:
About us



We run a fast-growing YouTube channel. Each video starts as a topic, and we gather many short clips for it, pick the best ones, write narration, edit, and publish. Much of our editing uses automation and AI, which makes a careful human review even more important.



This is our first content manager role. You'll start by doing the review work yourself. As we grow, you'll hire, train, and lead a team of reviewers who report to you.





What you will do



Clip review

- Watch the clips gathered for each topic and approve or reject them

- Check each clip: is it engaging, on topic, good enough quality, and not something we've already used?

- Flag clips that may cause copyright problems or don't meet our standards



Video review

- Watch finished videos before they go live and check them against our quality standards

- Catch problems such as a clip that doesn't fit, narration over the wrong clip, audio issues, awkward cuts, or a weak opening

- Approve the video, or send it back with clear, timestamped notes the editor can act on right away

- Make small editing fixes yourself when needed



Team management

- Help us hire and train new reviewers

- Assign daily clip and video review tasks and keep work on schedule

- Check your team's work, give feedback, and make sure everyone reviews to the same standard

- Spot recurring problems and suggest ways to improve our process

- Report to the owner on progress, quality, and anything blocking the work





What we are looking for



- 2+ years of experience in video content work: YouTube, social media, video editing, or content QA

- Video editing skills (Premiere Pro or similar). You won't edit full time, but you need to understand editing well and be able to step in when needed

- A strong eye for what makes a clip engaging and what makes a video feel polished

- A good understanding of YouTube: retention, pacing, and why some videos perform better than others

- Experience leading or training people, or a clear wish to grow into that role

- Excellent written English. Your feedback needs to be short, clear, and specific

- Very organized and reliable: you meet deadlines and keep track of many tasks at once

- Comfortable learning new web-based tools quickly

- Basic knowledge of YouTube copyright and Content ID is a plus





Details



- Full-time remote work, 40 hours per week

- Starting salary around USD 1,000 per month, depending on experience. The final amount is agreed with the right candidate

- Salary grows as you take on more responsibility and the team grows

- Working hours to be agreed with the right candidate

- Long-term role with a clear path to leading a team

- You'll need a reliable internet connection fast enough to stream HD video, a computer, and a quiet place to work





How to apply



Please send:

1. A short introduction (5 to 8 sentences) about your experience with video content, video editing, and leading people

2. Links to YouTube channels or other content you've worked on, and what your role was



Start your application with the words "Clip Review Lead" so we know you read the full post. We won't consider applications without them.



Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test: reviewing some sample clips and one finished video.

title: Direct Response Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
