Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply



 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

This role owns that. You'll d
 what each client should be known for, turn that into a content direction, and make sure every video and post that goes out actually builds it. You'll run strategy and insights calls with clients, direct our creative team, and read the numbers to d
 what comes next. If you've ever looked at an advisor's Instagram and thought "I know exactly what's wrong with this," keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work with our operations manager, accounts manager and creative team (videographers, editors and designers), with direct access to the founder. Main platforms are Instagram and
, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate. Every client's content serves one of two goals: winning clients or recruiting agents. You need to know which one you're writing for, every time.



What you'll do

- Define each client's positioning: what they stand for, who they're for, and why anyone should listen to them over the next advisor

- Build monthly content direction and campaigns that ladder up to the client's sales or recruitment goal

- Run brainstorming and insights calls with clients, pull out the stories and opinions only they have, and turn them into content angles

- Present strategy and content ideas to clients and get alignment without watering the ideas down

- Brief and direct scriptwriters, editors and designers, and review output before it goes out. If it's generic, it doesn't ship

- Review performance monthly, identify what's building authority and what's just filling the feed, and adjust

- Build our playbook as you go, so every winning format and angle compounds across clients



How you'll be measured

- Brand growth for your clients: reach and follower growth within the right audience, not vanity numbers

- Inbound signals: DMs, enquiries, and recruitment interest that clients trace back to content

- Client retention and renewals on the accounts you own

- First-pass approval: how often your direction and ideas land with clients without rounds of rework

- You'll see these numbers every month. Good strategists want to be measured. It's how you prove your thinking works.



You'll do well here if you

- Care about the difference between content that gets views and content that builds trust, and chase the second

- Can walk into a client call, disagree with a top producer respectfully, and back it up with reasoning

- Study why a creator's content works, not just that it works

- Give sharp, specific feedback to creatives instead of "make it pop"

- Take feedback well. Your strategies get challenged and reworked. That's how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

- Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

- Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We're not saying no life outside work. We're saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

- Think strategy means a content calendar full of "tips Tuesday" and trending audio

- Prefer taking client instructions as given rather than pushing for what will actually work

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

- You've run content strategy for personal brands or service professionals

- Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

- Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

- Real ownership of client accounts. Your strategy d
 what gets made

- Direct access to the founder. You learn how the whole business is built, from authority to inbound

- A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

- Real room to grow into a senior strategy or account lead role as we scale



How to apply

 
 with the subject line: Your Next Content Strategist - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

1. Cover letter: years of strategy experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

2. Updated CV/Resume

3. Portfolio: 2 to 3 accounts or campaigns you shaped, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining your strategic choices and what happened

4. One short exercise: pick any financial advisor or real estate agent in Singapore on Instagram. In a few lines, tell us what their content is getting wrong, what they should be known for instead, and give us 3 video ideas with hooks for their next month. We're looking at how you think

5. Expected salary in SGD only

Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, and they measure us on one thing: leads that turn into booked calls and closed business.

This role owns that engine. You’ll lead our ads department from day one, running Meta campaigns end to end across our client accounts, with real budget responsibility and real say in strategy. You’ll work directly with the founder. We’re not hiring someone to press buttons in Ads Manager. We’re hiring someone who wants to own outcomes.



What the setup looks like

You’ll lead a small ads team with different specialist skill sets across media buying, copy and funnels. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast, which means the team under you grows as we do. Meta is the main channel, YouTube is a plus. Stack includes GoHighLevel. Client accounts and our processes are documented, so you’re not walking into a mess.



What you’ll do

• Own Meta campaigns end to end: strategy, structure, launch, optimisation and scaling

• Make the performance calls: what to turn off, what to scale, what to test next, and explain why

• Direct creative: give the copywriter and creative team briefs so clear they can execute without a second meeting

• Protect the funnel: catch landing page and tracking issues before they waste budget

• Keep clients in the loop: your analysis and recommendations go to clients through our ops team, so clients always know what’s happening and why

• Run the weekly ads huddle and keep every account’s status honest





How you’ll be measured

Steady lead costs across the accounts you manage, fast turnaround on launches and fixes, and accounts kept healthy. If you like being judged on results instead of activity, you’ll enjoy this.



You’ll do well here if you

• Feel personally responsible when a campaign underperforms, before anyone points it out

• Can look at an account and tell a clear story: what’s working, why, and what you’re testing next

• Think in full funnels: ad, landing page, offer, follow up, not just what happens inside Ads Manager

• Communicate clearly and proactively. The team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Want a quiet execution role where someone else makes the decisions

• Have freelance ad accounts or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

• Report numbers without opinions. “CTR dropped 12%” is data. “CTR dropped because the hook fatigued, and here’s the next test” is the job

No hard feelings either way. Different roles suit different people.



Bonus points

• You’ve run lead generation for service businesses

• Bigger bonus: financial advisory, insurance or real estate

• Biggest bonus: Singapore market experience



What you get

• Lead the ads department from day one, working directly with the founder

• Real decision-making power: you shape strategy, not just execute someone else’s plan

• A team that invests in its people: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, overseas team trips

• As the agency scales, your scope and team scale with you

 with the subject line:

s

title: Admin & Bookkeeping VA | Exp in Aroflo, Trades
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on Aroflo experience, strong Xero skills and a background in Australian trades or construction admin will be prioritised for this role.



A fast-growing Australian plumbing and roofing business needs a part-time VA, initially 20 hours per week across Monday to Friday afternoons, to take ownership of the admin and bookkeeping workload that has built up alongside rapid growth. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role with a strong bookkeeping component. The right person will be confident in Xero and Australian bookkeeping fundamentals, with enough initiative to work autonomously during a business day when the owner is largely unreachable on-site.



A key part of the role is Aroflo, the business’s newly adopted job management platform, which replaces its previous job management and variation tracking tools. The owner is swamped and wants someone who can manage the platform on his behalf rather than someone he has to teach. Recorded training from Aroflo is available if your knowledge isn’t yet strong, but the expectation is that you take ownership of the system and become the go-to person for it.



The challenge being solved is straightforward: the owner is doing the financial and administrative work himself because there is no one else to do it, and it’s costing him the time and headspace he needs to win work and build the team. There is enough work to justify a full-time hire in the foreseeable future; the part-time start is about setting the right person up well before expanding their hours.



Success at 90 days looks like Aroflo running smoothly with you as the point person, daily reconciliation and invoicing running without the owner’s involvement, job-level cost tracking maintained consistently, outstanding invoices being chased, and payroll preparation happening on schedule. The owner should be opening his inbox to a clean summary, not a list of tasks still to do himself.



What You’ll Own



Aroflo Ownership & Systems Management



Take ownership of Aroflo as the owner’s day-to-day administrator, so he doesn’t need to work in the platform himself

Work through Aroflo’s recorded training (if needed) and become the in-house point person for how the system is used

Keep jobs, clients, quotes, scheduling and invoicing data accurate and up to date

Identify where the team’s use of Aroflo is inconsistent or incomplete, and flag or fix it

Document how Aroflo is used in the business through SOPs, so processes don’t depend on any one person



Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Reconcile Xero weekly and flag any unmatched transactions for review

Process and manage invoices: review, allocate, and confirm against jobs in Aroflo

Track and document approved variations to ensure all chargeable work is captured before a job closes

Follow up outstanding invoices as directed

Assist with payroll data preparation for review and submission

Support BAS and IAS data preparation each quarter, flagging key dates in advance

Process supplier payments as directed via WISE or an equivalent platform

Keep on top of outstanding bills and flag upcoming payment deadlines



Invoicing & Variation Tracking



Review completed jobs in Aroflo weekly and identify any un-invoiced or under-invoiced variations

Cross-check field reports against the scope of work and flag anything not yet charged

Prepare and send invoices through Aroflo, ensuring ABN, address, quantities and scope details are correct



Job-Level Cost Tracking & Reporting



Maintain job-level spreadsheets tracking cost versus income for each active job

Pull weekly data from Aroflo to update job profitability trackers

Identify jobs where costs are high relative to expected margins and flag for review

Compile a weekly job summary covering what has been invoiced, what’s in progress, and what’s outstanding

Track supplier invoices against jobs and ensure costs are allocated correctly



Inbox & Communication Management



Filter and manage the owner’s inbox daily: categorise, action, and forward invoices to Xero as required

Ensure no client follow-ups or leads go unanswered, flagging anything needing direct attention

Handle routine supplier communication: order confirmations and delivery queries

Send job confirmation, scheduling and follow-up messages to clients as directed



Scheduling & Task Management



Assist with managing the job calendar and scheduling in Aroflo as directed

Coordinate subcontractor and team scheduling when instructed

Set reminders for recurring tasks: invoicing runs, payroll deadlines, vehicle registrations, licence renewals and subscriptions

Maintain a running list of ideas and pending tasks so nothing falls through the cracks



SOP Documentation & Systems



Document processes as they’re learned, in real time rather than retrospectively

Maintain and update task records in Asana with daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Contribute to the business handbook as the role develops, creating a source of truth for each task



Daily Communication



Send a morning WhatsApp message with top priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything requiring attention or approval



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Experience in general admin and bookkeeping support in an Australian business context

Familiar with Australian bookkeeping basics: GST, invoicing, reconciliation, payroll, BAS/IAS

Hands-on Aroflo experience is highly desirable and would be a standout

Where Aroflo experience is limited, experience with comparable trade job management software and the ability to learn Aroflo quickly using the recorded training is essential

Prior experience with trades or construction businesses is a strong advantage

Comfortable working in a small, fast-growing business without formalised systems



Technical Proficiency



Aroflo: strong experience preferred, with recorded training available to supplement

Xero: required, with strong practical proficiency

Confident with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

Able to build and maintain job-level cost tracking spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets

Comfortable with WhatsApp, including voice notes, as the primary comms channel

Basic proficiency in Asana, or willing to learn



Organisational Skills



High attention to detail, particularly when reviewing invoices, variations and job costs

Able to manage a high-volume inbox and triage effectively without daily direction

Capable of maintaining multiple active job trackers simultaneously without losing accuracy

Proactive about setting reminders and following up on time-sensitive items



Communication Skills



Strong written and verbal English, as you will handle client and supplier communication directly

Brief, clear and to the point; phone calls are preferred for urgent matters, with voice notes and short WhatsApp messages for day-to-day

Comfortable batching questions into a single call rather than interrupting multiple times

Confident enough to follow up on outstanding information rather than waiting



Non-Negotiables



Works autonomously for extended periods without daily check-ins

Initiates tasks without being prompted and doesn’t wait for direction on repeatable processes

Fast learner on platforms, able to teach themselves through recorded training, SOPs and on-the-job experience

Treats the numbers as business-critical: understands that missed variations, untracked costs and late invoices have real dollar consequences

Raises flags early when something doesn’t look right, without going off on their own without the owner’s awareness

Naturally documents what they learn and builds processes that don’t rely on memory

Comfortable with ambiguity in a business that is still building its systems

Discreet and trustworthy with financial data, client information and business-level detail



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday afternoons (exact hours TBC at placement)

Genuine path to full-time once settled in and capability is proven

Primary point of contact is largely unreachable on-site during the day; a second-in-charge is available by phone in their absence



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of both the platform and the financial backbone of a growing business

Become the go-to person for Aroflo, with real trust and autonomy from day one

A clear, stated path to full-time hours as the role proves out

Future scope to grow into lead generation and CRM work as the business expands



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building
description:

Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Process Documentation

 & Customer Communication

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)

 and 
 using Meta Business Suite

Business Development & Lead Pipeline

Support outreach and marketing materials as directed



Task & Communication Management

 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

What We’re Looking For



Experience

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

Technical Proficiency (Core, Non-Negotiable)



Asana: experience or strong ability to set up and manage task boards, project pipelines and linked SOPs

Microsoft 365/Teams: comfortable with Outlook
, Teams video and associated tools

Confident, fast learner on job management or trades platforms

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT): genuine, proactive curiosity, not just baseline familiarity — actively pushes their own use of these tools rather than waiting to be shown

Strong written English for professional, client-facing communications



Technical Proficiency (Nice-to-Have)



Instagram and
 scheduling and 
 via Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn page-building experience from a low base

WordPress: minor content and photo updates; SEO/landing-page skills are a bonus

Xero experience is valuable but not mandatory for day one



Communication & Independence



Proactive, not passive — raises questions, confirms understanding, and flags issues before they become problems

Earns trust quickly with busy, selective directors

Confident enough to suggest a better way and push back constructively

Comfortable on frequent video calls, including impromptu check-ins



Organisational Skills



Manages multiple concurrent workstreams (admin, job platform,
 follow-up, SOP creation, light social scheduling) without dropping the ball

Strong self-directed time management within a 4-hour daily shift

Captures tasks, ideas and follow-up items in Asana unprompted



Non-Negotiables



Demonstrable, verifiable experience — real work samples and portfolio evidence are required, not just a strong interview

Consistent performance under sustained, low-supervision conditions, week after week — not just in the first few weeks

Process-minded: sees a repeatable task and thinks about how to document it, who owns it, and how long it should take

Comfortable with ambiguity — many processes are still being built in real time, and the VA helps create them, not just follow them

Treats every output — a caption, a quote, a drafted invoice — as representing an established, 19-year business

Fast learner on new platforms, particularly the job management system and Asana



Working Arrangements



Starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with a realistic path to full-time as more tasks are handed over

Regular video calls, including impromptu check-ins while a director is on the road



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of operations and SOP-building in a business actively working to become less founder-dependent

Real trust extended quickly to someone who proves they can be handed something and not need chasing

title: FBA Manager
description:
The Role

As our Amazon FBA Manager, you will be the captain of our Amazon storefront. You will balance daily operational logistics with long-term growth strategies to maximize revenue, maintain healthy profit margins, and protect our account standing. You will treat this channel as your own business, driving decision-making from inventory forecasting to PPC bid management.



Key Responsibilities

Listing Optimization (SEO): Create, update, and optimize product listings using competitive keyword research to maximize conversion rates. Manage A+ Content, storefront design, and backend search terms.



Inventory & Supply Chain: Forecast demand, track stock levels, and coordinate with suppliers/3PLs to ensure seamless fulfillment into Amazon centers. Prevent stockouts while actively avoiding long-term storage fees.



PPC & Promotions: Design, execute, and monitor Amazon Sponsored Ads (Products, Brands, Display). Adjust bidding strategies to maintain a profitable ACoS. Plan and execute promotions for Prime Day, Q4, and other seasonal events.



Account Health: Monitor Seller Central daily for policy warnings, stranded inventory, and listing suppressions. Escalate and resolve support cases, manage customer reviews, and ensure strict compliance with Amazon’s Terms of Service.



Market Intelligence: Analyze market trends, track competitor pricing, and identify profitable opportunities for new product variations or line extensions.



What We’re Looking For

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA accounts (Seller Central) with a proven track record of scaling revenue.

Analytical Skills: Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret sales metrics, calculate landed costs, and track contribution margins.

Tool Mastery: Proficiency with industry-standard Amazon software such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, or SellerBoard.

Ad Strategy: Deep understanding of Amazon PPC strategies and bid management.

Problem Solver: You know how to navigate Amazon's complex ticketing system and aren't afraid to push for resolutions.



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.

- You're organized and can manage multiple accounts and deadlines

- You work independently and take ownership of results

- You're data-driven and always testing and improving

- You have excellent written English

- You communicate clearly and proactively

- You take feedback well and adapt quickly



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Please do not apply unless you have:

- Proven professional experience managing social media accounts (required)

HOW TO APPLY

Applications missing any section below will not be reviewed.

Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, X, Threads

Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, your preferred scheduling tool(s), Photoshop, and any AI tools you use

title: Remote Sales Representative / Client Coordinator (Fluent in English) - (US Hours) (MALE only)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



(Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.)



We are hiring a Client Advisors / Crisis Response Coordinators to join our remote team. We are currently hiring for Shift C. The shift schedule is based on Manila Time / Philippine Time (PHT).



As part of your application, please send a 60-second English voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you are a strong fit for this role, and briefly summarizing your phone-based sales, client support, or customer service experience.



Important Requirement:

- This is a full-time, dedicated role. We are looking for candidates who can fully commit to their assigned shift.

- This role is not suitable as a second job, side job, or additional freelance role. Because response time, reliability, and emotional availability are critical in this position, candidates must not be working another job that conflicts with their schedule, focus, or performance.



About the Role

- This role includes a sales component, but it is not an aggressive sales role.

- You will not be cold-calling random prospects or pushing products.

- Your job is to respond quickly to inbound inquiries, calm the client when needed, understand the urgency of the case, explain how the service works, recommend the right service package, and guide the client through agreement, payment, onboarding, and handoff to our operations team.

- We are looking for candidates with a mature, steady, and confident phone presence. The right person should sound calm under pressure, communicate clearly with US-based clients, and handle sensitive conversations professionally.



What You'll Do

- Respond to inbound leads through phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and messaging platforms within minutes.

-Conduct first consultations by listening to the client's situation, assessing urgency, and recommending the most suitable service package.

- Explain the services, pricing, onboarding steps, contracts, and expectations clearly.

- Guide clients through the agreement, payment, and onboarding process.

-Coordinate with the operations team after the client signs up to ensure a smooth case handoff.

- Follow up with clients at key milestones, including after 24 hours, weekly updates, and service completion.

- Maintain accurate records in our dashboard, including lead status, call notes, messages, contracts, and follow-up tasks.

- Collect client feedback and reviews after successful service completion.

- Work reliably during your assigned shift to ensure fast response coverage.

- What We're Looking For

- At least 2 years of phone-based sales, customer service, client consultation, call center, or account support experience.

- Clear spoken English and the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients.

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong empathy and emotional control when speaking with distressed clients.

- Ability to guide a conversation without sounding pushy or aggressive.

- Experience handling objections, pricing conversations, and follow-ups.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

- Ability to fully commit to this role as your primary work commitment.

- Fast and stable internet connection.

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Own computer, headset, and microphone.

- Comfortable using CRM, dashboard, messaging, and calling tools.



Nice to Have

- Experience in legal services, insurance, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare support, emergency support, trust and safety, or crisis-related customer service.

- Previous experience working with US-based clients.

- Inbound sales, client advisory, retention, or customer success background.

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important. 



Available Shift Schedules

- We are currently hiring for the following shift C (Manila Time / PHT):



Shift C: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (PHT)



Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



Compensation & Growth

Base salary: $800/month

Commission: 3%–5% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.

Employee Benefits

Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

$10 bonus per verified customer review.

$300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

7 days paid annual leave per year.

3 days paid sick leave per year (no doctor's note required).

2× pay for work on Philippine regular public holidays.

Guaranteed weekly rest day

Hiring Process

Application review.

Resume/CV and voice recording review.

Written screening assessment.

Live interview with scenario-based questions.

Reference/profile check.

Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.



How to Apply: Please submit your resume/CV and a 60-second English voice recording.



Your recording should include:

- A brief introduction of yourself.

- Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.

- A short summary of your phone-based sales, customer service, call center, client consultation, or account support experience.

- Confirmation that you can fully commit to the shift you apply for and that this will be your primary full-time job.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Who We Are



Raicom LLC operates a portfolio of high-volume e-commerce brands that sell supplements. We sell through direct-to-consumer storefronts and online marketplaces, and work with manufacturers, suppliers, freight partners, and US warehouses to keep products available across those channels.



Our procurement team works closely with teams across the business. We use sales demand to plan purchases, coordinate incoming inventory, and share order and shipment updates. This helps us catch delays early, prevent stockouts, and keep customers informed.



We’re looking for an organized, experienced procurement professional who can help keep inventory, orders, and logistics running smoothly.



We care about doing good work and enjoy doing it together. At Raicom, that means supporting teammates, bringing a positive attitude, and speaking honestly when something needs attention. We value a sense of fun and respect each other’s time and boundaries.



The Role



You’ll work alongside our Procurement Manager and Senior Leadership team to keep products in stock. You’ll start on our direct-to-consumer purchasing and logistics in Fulfil. As we expand into Amazon, you’ll take ownership of Amazon replenishment and FBA inbound shipments. You’ll follow approved orders from supplier confirmation through warehouse receipt.



You’ll also be the procurement team’s backup and its coverage during US business hours, while our Procurement Manager is offline. That means answering warehouse questions, keeping orders moving, and knowing when something can wait and when it can’t.



If production slips, you’ll estimate how long stock will last, ask about a partial shipment, and recommend the next step. With training, you’ll take ownership of routine purchasing, freight bookings, transfers, and cycle counts.



What you’ll do



Amazon



- Plan FBA replenishment using sales velocity, stock levels, and inbound dates.

- Build FBA shipment plans in Seller Central and coordinate prep, labels, quantities, and ship dates with the warehouse.

- Track inbound shipments through receipt and resolve discrepancies with Amazon and the warehouse.

- Turn what you learn into clear SOPs, so the process doesn’t live in one person’s head.



Purchasing



- Create approved purchase orders in Fulfil (our ERP). Confirm pricing and quantities, then track production through receipt.

- Manage component and packaging POs for products assembled by our US contract manufacturers.

- Follow up with suppliers so orders keep moving without anyone having to chase.



Logistics



- Create internal shipments, compare LTL freight quotes, and book the most cost-effective reliable carrier.

- Confirm pickups, share shipping documents, and track deliveries to our US warehouses.



Inventory and warehouse support



- Monitor stock levels and inbound dates. Flag stockout risks early and recommend options, such as partial shipments or revised delivery dates.

- Be the go-to contact for our US warehouses during their business hours: locate POs, confirm packaging ETAs, and investigate short, missing, or damaged shipments.

- Coordinate weekly cycle counts and route inventory adjustments for approval.

- Support PO, receipt, and invoice reconciliation with Accounting.



Making it better



- Write and update SOPs as you learn each workflow.

- Spot recurring supplier delays and fix the process, not just the instance.

- What We’re Looking For



Must have



- Hands-on, end-to-end purchasing experience: PO creation, supplier follow-up, shipment coordination, and receipt.

- Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA inbound shipment planning.

- Working knowledge of shipping from China to the US, including documents and freight timing.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets). You compare quotes, reconcile quantities, and double-check SKUs, units, and dates.

- The judgment to read sales trends, stock levels, and inbound dates, and say when to reorder.

- Clear written and spoken English. You raise risks early and close the loop.

- The ability to work US Eastern hours consistently.



Strongly preferred



- Experience in dietary supplements, including Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).



Nice to have



- 
 or a similar ERP or inventory system

- Shopify, or Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) orders

- US contract manufacturers, bills of materials, or manufacturing orders

- US FDA requirements for dietary supplements

title: UGC Creator & Influencer Coordinator

Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently drive projects forward.

A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with a genuine interest in creative performance and marketing.

Discover and recruit UGC creators, influencers, and TikTok creators who align with our brands, products, and target audiences.

Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified creators for continuous content production.

Identify new creator segments and sourcing opportunities that can expand our reach and creative possibilities.

Build long-term relationships with reliable creators who can become recurring brand partners.

Manage the end-to-end creator collaboration process, from initial outreach and recruitment to final content delivery.

Coordinate creative briefs, product shipments, deadlines, revisions, approvals, and deliverables.

Evaluate creators based on content quality, authenticity, communication, audience fit, and potential to produce effective advertising assets.

Negotiate creator rates, deliverables, usage rights, and collaboration terms.

Maintain strong relationships that encourage repeat collaborations and consistent content production.

Your impact: Ensure our creative team receives a steady supply of quality UGC without unnecessary delays or production bottlenecks.



3. Help Power Our Winning Advertising Creatives

Collaborate with Creative Strategists and Media Buyers to understand the creators, content styles, and messaging angles needed for upcoming campaigns.

Source creators who can effectively communicate product benefits, address customer pain points, and create compelling content.

Support the production of creator-led advertisements designed for creative testing and paid media campaigns.

Coordinate Meta whitelisting and Partnership Ads, ensuring all necessary creator authorizations are secured.

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop creators and affiliates to support creator-led content and affiliate initiatives.

Your impact: Help our team test more creative concepts, explore new advertising opportunities, and develop content with the potential to become winning ads.



4. Protect Our Brand and Creator Partnerships

Negotiate creator compensation, deliverables, usage rights, and advertising permissions.

Secure the necessary content usage rights and creator authorizations before assets are used in campaigns.

Coordinate creator agreements and ensure collaboration terms are clearly documented.

Your impact: Give our team confidence that the content we produce is properly authorized and ready for marketing use.



5. Build Systems That Can Scale With the Business

Identify opportunities to improve creator sourcing, outreach, onboarding, and production workflows.

Track recruitment activity, creator responsiveness, content delivery, and relevant campaign indicators.

Identify high-quality creators who are worth developing into long-term brand partners.

Continuously improve the creator pipeline to support increasing creative production demands across our brands.

Your impact: Help transform creator recruitment from a series of individual collaborations into a repeatable, scalable growth system.



Why Join Enclave BioActives?



Make an Impact That Goes Beyond Your Job Title.

Own Something Meaningful: Take the lead in building and developing a creator network that becomes an important asset to our business.

See the Results of Your Work: Your recruitment efforts will directly contribute to the creative content our brands use to reach and convert customers.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?



This opportunity is ideal for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do.

You enjoy finding great talent, building relationships, negotiating partnerships, and making sure projects get done. You understand that great UGC can be more than engaging content—it can become a powerful advertising asset that helps a business grow.



We're not simply looking for someone to coordinate creators. We're looking for someone who can build the creator network, systems, and partnerships that help drive our next stage of growth.

CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointment statuses.

Proven experience in B2B cold calling and appointment setting.

Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with business owners.

Experience building and managing outbound prospecting systems.

Ability to explain a detailed, repeatable cold calling process.

Experience with lead generation, qualification, objection handling, and follow-ups.

Highly organized, proactive, and capable of working independently.

Comfortable tracking performance through measurable KPIs.

Compensation:

$500 USD monthly base pay

Required

• Paid time off and Philippine holidays observed

• Training on our service packages, pricing, and sales process

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and attach your resume. A short voice or video recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself is a strong plus.

title: Compliance Coordinator
description:
TSGBH is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Compliance Coordinator to support our behavioral health operations.



This position will help ensure that required documentation, employee files, client records, credentialing information, training requirements, and internal compliance processes are completed accurately and on time.



This is not simply an administrative assistant position. We need someone who can review records, identify missing or expired items, follow up with staff, maintain compliance trackers, and escalate concerns before they become larger problems.



Key Responsibilities



* Review employee and contractor files for required documentation

* Monitor expiration dates for licenses, credentials, certifications, trainings, and other required documents

* Maintain compliance tracking spreadsheets and internal systems

* Review client records for missing or incomplete documentation

* Monitor required signatures, assessments, treatment documents, and administrative forms

* Follow up with employees regarding missing or overdue compliance items

* Track onboarding and annual compliance requirements

* Assist with employee credentialing and recredentialing documentation

* Assist with payer and provider enrollment documentation as assigned

* Organize documents for internal and external audits

* Conduct routine file audits using established checklists

* Document compliance findings and corrective actions

* Monitor deadlines and send reminders before items become overdue

* Maintain organized electronic compliance files

* Assist management with policy and procedure tracking

* Review records for consistency with company requirements

* Report significant compliance concerns to management

* Assist with corrective action follow-up

* Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:



* Healthcare compliance

* Behavioral health administration

* Medical records

* Credentialing

* Human resources compliance

* Quality assurance

* Healthcare documentation

* Medicaid provider operations

* HIPAA-related administrative work



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare or behavioral health organization** is a major advantage.



Skills Needed



The successful candidate must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly organized

* Comfortable reviewing large amounts of documentation

* Able to identify missing, incomplete, or expired information

* Comfortable following up repeatedly when required

* Able to maintain accurate tracking systems

* Able to meet deadlines without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating professionally with employees and management

* Able to protect confidential information

* Comfortable learning new systems and processes

* Strong in written English

* Reliable and consistent with attendance



 What Success Looks Like



We do not want someone who simply checks boxes.



We need someone who asks:



**What is missing?

What is expiring soon?

Who is responsible for correcting it?

Has the issue been resolved?

What creates a risk for the organization?

What needs to be escalated to management?**



The goal of this position is to help prevent compliance problems before they become audit findings, payment issues, employee credentialing problems, or operational risks.



Daily Compliance Expectations



The Compliance Specialist should maintain a clear record of:



* Items reviewed

* Deficiencies identified

* Employees or departments contacted

* Items corrected

* Items still outstanding

* Upcoming expiration dates

* Issues requiring management attention



Every compliance issue should have a clear status and next action.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Employees who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, accuracy, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage compliance responsibilities with limited supervision may be considered for future compensation reviews and expanded responsibilities.



Schedule



Candidates must be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable internet, a dependable computer, and a quiet professional workspace are required.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe any experience you have with healthcare, compliance, credentialing, medical records, or quality assurance.

3. Have you previously worked for a U.S.-based healthcare company?

4. What systems or software have you used?

5. Describe how you would manage 50 employees with certifications and licenses that expire on different dates.

6. If you discovered that an employee's required credential expired two weeks ago, what steps would you take?

7. Describe how you stay organized when managing multiple deadlines.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during U.S. Eastern Time.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



Important



This position requires someone who is comfortable holding others accountable for completing required documentation.



You must be willing to follow up, document your efforts, identify risks, and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our compliance and administrative infrastructure—not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.

title: Billing & Claims Specialist
description:
TSGBH is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Billing & Claims Specialist to support our behavioral health billing operations.



This position is ideal for someone who has experience working with U.S. healthcare claims, insurance billing, Medicaid, claim follow-up, and payment reconciliation .



Your primary responsibility will be making sure services that have been provided are properly billed, claims are followed through to payment, and billing problems are identified and resolved quickly.



This is not simply a data-entry position. We need someone who can review a claim, identify why it has not been paid, and take the appropriate next step.



Key Responsibilities



* Submit and monitor insurance claims

* Review claims for accuracy before submission

* Track unpaid, pending, rejected, and denied claims

* Follow up with insurance companies and managed care organizations regarding claim status

* Review EOBs, ERAs, and payment information

* Identify claim denials and rejection reasons

* Correct and resubmit rejected or denied claims when appropriate

* Maintain an organized list of outstanding claims

* Post or reconcile insurance payments as assigned

* Verify that services documented have been billed

* Identify missing documentation that may prevent billing

* Identify authorization or eligibility problems affecting claims

* Communicate billing issues to management and clinical/administrative staff

* Maintain accurate notes regarding claim follow-up activity

* Assist with accounts receivable and aging reports

* Escalate claims that require additional intervention

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Healthcare billing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand or have experience with:



* U.S. healthcare insurance billing

* Behavioral health or mental health billing

* Medicaid claims

* CMS-1500/professional claims

* Claims submission

* Denials and rejections

* EOBs and ERAs

* Accounts receivable

* Insurance eligibility

* Prior authorizations

* Claim status follow-up

* Payment reconciliation





Skills Needed



The right person must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching billing problems

* Able to follow a claim from submission through payment

* Comfortable communicating professionally by email and telephone

* Able to document their work clearly

* Able to recognize when something does not look correct

* Reliable and consistent with attendance

* Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours



Strong written English and professional communication skills are required.



Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the billing process.



You should not simply report that a claim was denied.



We expect you to determine:



Why was it denied?

Can it be corrected?

What information is missing?

Who needs to take action?

What is the next step?



Our goal is to maintain clean claims, reduce denials, follow up aggressively on outstanding balances, and make sure the company receives payment for services that have been properly provided.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour with Bonus



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate. Performance, reliability, accuracy, and demonstrated ability to manage claims independently will be considered during future compensation reviews.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe your previous U.S. healthcare billing experience.

3. What types of insurance or Medicaid claims have you worked with?

4. Have you worked with behavioral health or mental health billing?

5. What billing or EHR systems have you used?

6. Describe how you would handle a claim that was submitted but has not been paid after 30 days.

7. Describe a denial you have handled in the past and how you resolved it.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during **U.S. Eastern Time**.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn our organization, take ownership of our claims, and become a dependable long-term member of our administrative team.

title: Performance Creative Designer — Static Ads
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Operations Manager – Residential Plumbing & Electrical Service Company
description:
Operations Manager – Residential Plumbing & Electrical Service Company 



About the role



We are hiring an experienced Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day execution of two residential home-service companies specializing in plumbing and electrical work.



You will keep operations organized, coordinate office and field teams, audit job flow, enforce company standards, resolve operational problems, and ensure important commitments are completed. You will be the primary link between the owner and daily operations.



This is a leadership and accountability position—not an executive assistant or task-runner role. You are responsible for making sure work gets done correctly, but you are not expected to personally complete everyone else’s responsibilities.



The right person knows how to create clear ownership, follow up consistently, address missed expectations, and improve systems without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.



OM Responsibilities include:

Daily operations: Coordinate office and field teams, monitor job flow, resolve operational issues, and ensure important work is completed on time.

Team leadership: Set expectations, enforce company standards, support employees, and hold team members accountable for results.

Job-flow auditing: Audit jobs from booking through payment, including notes, photos, estimates, approvals, collections, and next actions.

Reporting: Provide concise daily and weekly updates covering results, problems, responsible owners, deadlines, and next steps.

Processes and SOPs: Document, improve, train, and enforce practical company processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Meetings and projects: Manage meetings, projects, tasks, owners, deadlines, follow-ups, and successful implementation.

Hiring and access control: Manage recruiting, initial screening, interview coordination, onboarding, and access to company systems.

Administrative operations: Support payroll and bonus calculations, review management, Yelp lead oversight, insurance requests, permits, and inspections.

Candidates selected for an initial interview will receive the complete role description and detailed responsibilities for review before the interview.



Required Experience and Skills

At least three years of operations management, service management, or execution-management experience.

Experience in a service business such as plumbing, electrical, HVAC, garage doors, cleaning, restoration, or another home-service industry.

Demonstrated experience managing people and holding employees accountable.

Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-up discipline.

Ability to identify operational problems and drive them to resolution.

Experience creating, improving, and enforcing SOPs.

Confidence working with CRMs, spreadsheets, trackers, and dashboards.

Ability to audit work for accuracy and completeness.

Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

Sound judgment and the ability to remain calm under pressure.



Compensation:

$7–$9 USD per hour, depending on directly relevant experience. Full-time, 40 hours per week. Compensation will be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance.



About Us

We operate two residential service companies (plumbing and electrical) on the West Side of Los Angeles. Nine years in business, currently sixteen team members. We divide roles clearly, and every person is responsible for their results.



How to apply

Please follow every step below. Only complete applications will be reviewed.

 subject line: “Operations Manager – [Your First Name]”.

Include this exact phrase somewhere in your message: “Attentoin to details is my strength.”

Attach your resume.

title: Short Form Video Editor for an Indie Game (Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts)
description:
I’m looking for someone to help me create short videos for a turn based roguelite made entirely from text and ASCII art.



The game has ten playable classes, deep character builds, and a sci-fi setting. I want videos that show people why they’d want to play it, even if they’ve never tried an ASCII game before.



**What you’ll do**



- Turn gameplay footage into vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Come up with hooks and video ideas around combat, classes, builds, enemies, and interesting gameplay moments.

- Add captions, sound effects, and music where they help.

- Keep the gameplay readable on a phone screen.

- Create different hooks for promising clips so we can test what gets people watching.

- Work with me on feedback and revisions.



I can provide gameplay footage, screenshots, and information about the game. If you’re comfortable playing the game and recording your own clips, mention that in your application.



**Who I’m looking for**



You should have experience editing short form videos, ideally for games. You should know how to catch someone’s attention quickly and keep the video moving without covering everything in effects.



Textmor’s ASCII art is a big part of its identity. You’ll need to preserve the actual artwork and make thoughtful choices about cropping, zooming, and captions.



I’d especially like to work with someone who can suggest ideas and choose interesting moments, instead of needing instructions for every cut. An interest in indie games, roguelikes, or RPGs would help.



**Scope and pay**



This is a part time freelance role to start, with the possibility of ongoing work if we’re a good fit.



Please include your rate per video.



**How to apply**



Please send:



- Two or three examples of short videos you’ve edited, preferably gaming content.

- A brief explanation of what you handled in each example.

- Your rates, availability, and typical turnaround time.



I care more about your work and ideas than a long cover letter. If we seem like a good fit, we’ll start with a small paid trial. Please don't use AI to write your
 to me (AI writing is so generic.)

title: Viral Video Idea Researcher (Hair / Beauty, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "HAIR HOOK" OR IT WON'T BE READ.



Hours: About 4 hours/day, Monday to Saturday. Pick your own hours, but the daily doc is due by 9 AM EST.

Pay: $400 USD/month to start, with a raise after 60 days for consistent, high-quality work.



=== JOB OVERVIEW ===

I run several YouTube Shorts channels in the hair and beauty space. Your whole job is to find winning video ideas every day and deliver them to me in one Google Doc. When I open the doc each morning, the ideas should be ready to use with no extra research from me.



This is NOT a content creation job. You don't film, edit, or post anything. You find the ideas, check the numbers, and present them clearly.



=== HOW THE WORK IS DONE ===

You won't just scroll randomly. You'll train dedicated TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube accounts so their feeds only show the kind of content I want:

- Follow, watch, like, and save content from a list of specific creators and accounts I'll give you

- Keep adding new accounts you discover that post in the same style

- Teach the algorithm what to show you, so your feeds are full of fresh, relevant videos every day

- Pull the best ones from those feeds into the daily doc



Once hired, I'll explain the type of ideas I want for each channel, how many per day, and which accounts to start training on.



=== WHAT MAKES AN IDEA "WINNING" ===

Specific rules vary by channel, but in general every idea must be:

- Directly related to the channel's niche (mostly hair)

- Proven: a high view count, or a high outlier score (the video's views divided by the creator's average views)

- Recent: posted within the last couple of weeks

- Filmed on a phone, but clear and high quality: good lighting, sharp, vertical

- Grabs you visually in the first 1-2 seconds, even with the sound off



=== DAILY DELIVERABLE ===

A Google Doc (one tab per day). For each idea:

1. Link to the original video

2. Platform, views, and date posted

3. Outlier score

4. Which channel it's for

5. The hook: what happens in the first second (one sentence)

6. What happens in the video (1-2 sentences)

7. The angle: the tip, correction, or twist I could add



I'll mark which ideas I use, so you'll learn quickly what wins.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===

- You spend a lot of time on TikTok / Instagram / YouTube Shorts and understand how the algorithm and recommended feeds work

- Comfortable creating and managing separate accounts just for research

- Strong English reading and writing (the "angle" notes need to be clear)

- Reliable: the doc is there every day, on time

- Comfortable with Google Docs

- Interest in hair or beauty is a big plus



=== HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY) ===

Start your application with the words "HAIR HOOK" or it won't be read.



Then answer these:

1. Send 3 hair videos posted in the last 7 days that went viral. For each, write one sentence on why the first second makes people stop scrolling.

2. In 2-3 sentences: how would you train a new TikTok account so its feed only shows viral hair content?



The best applicants get a paid trial: one full day's doc after I brief you on the channels.

title: General Admin & Marketing Support VA | HVAC, Advanced ServiceM8
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with advanced, hands-on ServiceM8 experience (including automations, quote follow-up sequences and SMS templates) and a background running the full job cycle for an Australian trades or field service business will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian air conditioning and refrigeration business needs a part-time VA who can step into ServiceM8 at an advanced level and take immediate ownership of the full job cycle: monitoring every enquiry channel, entering jobs, answering client questions, quoting, booking and invoicing. ServiceM8 depth is the non-negotiable. The owner uses only the basics of the platform and wants a VA who knows it better than he does, can set up the workflows and automations that aren’t being used yet, and never needs to be taught the platform itself.



The second half of the role is marketing. In quieter periods, the VA will run social media, create simple content, send
 campaigns to the client database, and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta. When bookings slow down, marketing needs to kick in to fill the schedule.



Success looks like the owner finishing on the tools and being done for the day, a schedule that keeps the technicians (and an incoming apprentice) fully booked, and a winter that is busier than the last. This coming winter is the test of whether the role moves to full-time.



What You’ll Own



Enquiry Management



Monitor all enquiry channels throughout the shift, including ServiceM8 notifications, the ServiceM8 inbox, website message enquiries and

Follow up missed calls and enquiries captured by the AI receptionist

Enter new enquiries into ServiceM8 with complete client, site and job details

Follow up clients for missing information (address, unit details, photos, access) before progressing the job

Respond to client questions promptly and clearly, escalating technical queries

Make outbound calls through the ServiceM8 phone app for important matters only, as calls are charged per minute



Quoting



Prepare and send quotes in ServiceM8

Monitor ServiceM8’s automated five-step quote follow-up sequence and act on anything it misses



Booking & Scheduling



Book accepted jobs in ServiceM8 and confirm bookings with clients

Keep the schedule as full as possible for the field team, including a trainee and an incoming apprentice

Send booking confirmations and appointment reminders

Maintain accurate job statuses from quoted through to booked and completed



Invoicing



Issue invoices from ServiceM8 on job completion (syncs automatically to Xero)

Submit invoices through the relevant real estate agency’s platform for property management jobs (such as Ourtradie/OurProperty and Tapi), confirming the correct submission method for each agency

Follow up overdue invoices



Marketing Support



Prioritise admin first, stepping up marketing activity when bookings slow to keep the schedule full

Post on
 and Instagram via Meta Business Suite, respond to comments and messages, and create simple content and video edits

Develop and send
 campaigns to the client database, such as seasonal service offers

Review the existing, currently paused Google Ads account, then plan and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta

Submit all new marketing activity for approval before it goes live



Daily Communication & Systems



Send a start-of-shift WhatsApp message confirming log-on and the day’s priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing approval, attention or review

Document each task as an SOP during handover, using recordings of live training

Build advanced ServiceM8 knowledge and recommend workflow, template and automation improvements



What We’re Looking For



Experience



At least 2 years’ VA experience, ideally with Australian trades or field service businesses

Hands-on experience running the full job cycle for a trades business: enquiry, job setup, quoting, booking and invoicing

Experience with real estate and property management platforms such as Ourtradie/OurProperty and Tapi is a strong advantage, and you should be comfortable learning new agency portals quickly

Air conditioning, refrigeration or other service trade experience is a strong advantage



Communication Skills



Strong written English for enquiry replies and client
s: prompt, warm and clear

Clear spoken English at a measured pace on the phone, as you will call clients when needed

Comfortable answering client questions and knowing when to pass technical ones on



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8: advanced and non-negotiable, including automations, quote follow-up sequences, SMS templates and the ServiceM8 phone app

Comfortable managing several inboxes and enquiry channels at once

Social media posting and replies, Meta Business Suite, Canva, basic video editing, and using AI tools to create content

Proven experience running Meta Ads, Google Ads and
 campaigns is highly valued; some genuine paid ads exposure is expected

Basic awareness of Xero only; invoicing runs through ServiceM8 and bookkeeping is out of scope



Organisational Skills



Keeps an eye on three or four enquiry channels and makes sure nothing gets missed

Keeps ServiceM8 job statuses accurate from quote to booking to invoice

Plans the day so admin comes first and marketing fills the gaps



Non-Negotiables



Advanced ServiceM8 knowledge, with no platform training needed

Uses quiet days productively without being told what to do

Suggests improvements to ServiceM8 workflows, templates and automations

Writes up SOPs from live screen-share training and learned knowledge of the business

Comfortable taking direction from two points of contact



Working Arrangements

Open to, and genuinely wanting, a move to full-time as the role grows

Workload rises and falls with the season: busier admin in summer, more marketing in winter

Why This Role

Freedom to build and improve ServiceM8 workflows and automations that aren’t being used yet

A direct link between your marketing work and a full schedule, with real, visible results

Partner team by ensuring day to day care administration is actioned accurately, efficiently, and in line

with approved care plans, budgets, and internal processes. The purpose of the role is co-ordinating the

activities of daily living delivering quality care management services through the Support at Home

program for our aged care participants. Working closely with participants, families and various health

professionals you ensure services reflect each participant's assessed needs, preferences and available

funding.



The ideal candidate has very strong English speaking and writing skills. You are proactive, have high

degree of empathy, are detail oriented while communicating clearly and confidently. You have a passion

for making a difference in care participants lives, being part of a supportive team, rostering caregiver

schedules in the Support at Home program ensuring every care participant receives the care they

deserve. You'll manage shift changes and rosters along with administrative and financial areas of the

business so experience with Xero is an advantage.



You’ll enjoy a hybrid role work environment that fosters teamwork and professional growth. With

shared working schedule between our Cebu IT Park location and remotely from your home office.



Key Responsibilities include:



1. Task Processing and Administration

• Receive participant related requests and task handovers from the Senior Care Partner

• Convert instructions into clear actions and system updates

• Enter requests accurately into the relevant care or workflow system

• Process service bookings, cancellations, purchases, referrals, and invoice approval tasks

• Check care plan and budget alignment before actioning requests



2. Service Request Co-ordination

• Book approved participant services in line with care plans

• Liaise with rostering teams, providers, and internal stakeholders

• Confirm worker availability and participant preferences

• Resolve scheduling issues, changes, missed services, and escalate service issues promptly



3. Documentation and System Accuracy

• Record all actions, changes, and communications accurately

• Ensure documentation is complete, current, and audit ready

• Support strong system accuracy across participant tasks and service updates



4. Care Plan and Budget Support

• Action services only where they align with approved care plans and support arrangements

• Check that services are approved and funding is available before proceeding

• Identify and report budget risks, over-utilization, or unapproved requests

• Support the Senior Care Partner with accurate service and usage information



5. Participant and Provider Communication

• Confirm bookings, changes, and cancellations with participants and providers

• Provide general non clinical updates and service information

• Follow up providers on outstanding services or delivery issues

• Maintain professional and timely communication at all times
