title: Affiliate Content Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

title: Experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter – Business Funding | Base + Commission
description:
PillarStar Capital is a growing U.S. business-funding company looking for an experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter to join our team.



This is not an entry-level cold-calling position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), alternative business funding, and how to speak confidently with U.S. business owners.



Your primary goal is to turn leads into qualified merchants with completed applications and bank statements.



You will work leads provided by PillarStar and move merchants through:



Lead → Conversation → Interest → Qualification → Application/Bank Statements → Complete Package



Our processing and closing team will handle the later stages of the transaction.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners.

Speak with owners and decision makers.

Identify current or future business-funding needs.

Determine requested funding amount and use of funds.

Ask about monthly business revenue.

Identify existing MCA positions and payments.

Qualify merchants according to PillarStar guidelines.

Request applications and recent business bank statements.

Handle common merchant objections professionally.

Follow up aggressively but professionally with interested merchants.

Re-engage previous leads.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up dates.

Work closely with processing and closing staff.

Help consistently generate complete funding packages, not just calls.

Who We Are Looking For



2+ years of direct MCA/business-funding experience is strongly preferred.



You should already understand terms such as:



First position

Second position

Stacking

Daily/weekly payments

Bank statements

Revenue qualification

Funding applications



You should also have:



Strong spoken English.

Clear, confident phone presence.

Experience calling U.S. business owners.

Strong objection-handling skills.

Experience asking merchants for applications and bank statements.

CRM and outbound-dialer experience.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Backup internet/power.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation



Starting rate: $4.00/hour



Strong candidates with verifiable MCA experience may start higher, up to $5.00/hour.



There will be a 30-day performance review, with opportunities for increases based on results.



You will also earn:



5% of PillarStar Capital's commission actually collected on funded transactions originating from your assigned leads.



Commission is earned only after the transaction funds and PillarStar receives its commission.



As the company grows, strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, bonuses, senior sales responsibilities, and advancement into closing roles.



How Performance Is Measured



We care about results, not meaningless dialing.



We measure:



Calls → Merchant Conversations → Interested Merchants → Applications/Statements Requested → Complete Packages → Funded Deals



We also measure call quality, attendance, follow-up, CRM accuracy, professionalism, and package quality.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PILLARSTAR MCA – [Your Name] – [Years of MCA Experience]



Please submit:



1. Your resume



2. A REQUIRED 60–90 second voice sample



In your normal speaking voice:



Introduce yourself.

Tell us how many years of MCA/business-funding experience you have.

Give us a 20–30 second example of how you would open a call with a U.S. business owner.

Then answer this merchant objection:



“I'm not sending you my bank statements until you tell me what rate you're offering.”



Do not submit an AI-generated voice.



Answer These 7 Questions

How many years have you worked specifically in MCA or alternative business funding? What were your roles?

In your most recent MCA role, approximately how many complete applications + bank-statement packages did you personally generate per week?

Approximately how many funded transactions per month originated from your opportunities, if your company tracked this?

Explain the difference between a first-position MCA, second-position MCA, and stacking.

Write exactly what you would say if a merchant tells you:

“I'm not sending statements until you tell me the rate.”

Which MCA CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms have you previously used?

What hourly rate are you currently seeking, and are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours?



Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and live MCA merchant role-play.

title: General Virtual Assistant and Leadership Team Member (US Company)
description:
ABOUT US



We’re a small US medical education company that has been helping pediatricians pass their board exams for over fifteen years.



We’re an established business, but in many ways, we still operate with the energy and flexibility of a startup. Our team is small, people wear more than one hat, and we genuinely support one another. We work closely together, and maintaining a positive, collaborative environment is something we really value.



WHAT THIS JOB IS



We’re looking for someone who can take on two important parts of the business, and we want to be clear about what both involve.



The first is general support. This means helping wherever the team needs you most, whether that’s following up with vendors, keeping projects moving, handling logistics, or picking up tasks that have been waiting for attention. Some responsibilities will be routine, and that’s part of keeping a small business running smoothly.



The second is something you don’t often find in a typical VA role.



We’d love for you to be part of our leadership discussions. As a small team, we regularly exchange ideas about marketing, sales, pricing, and opportunities for expansion. We’re looking for someone who can bring their own experience, perspectives, and ideas to those conversations.



We want someone who enjoys thinking about the bigger picture but is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves and getting things done.



We’re also preparing to launch a second product, a mobile app in a new market. Helping move that project forward will likely be one of your biggest responsibilities early on.



WHAT YOU’D BE DOING



* Supporting the team with different operational and administrative needs as priorities change.

* Keeping multi-step projects moving, particularly those involving external vendors and deadlines.

* Helping coordinate and drive the launch of our new mobile app.

* Participating in leadership discussions and sharing ideas about marketing, sales, expansion, and business growth.

* Helping revisit projects that have stalled and finding ways to move them forward.

* Documenting processes and workflows so we can work more efficiently as a team.

* Coordinating with specialists and contractors across different time zones.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Management or leadership experience. You won’t be directly managing people in this role, but we’d love someone who has worked at that level and can bring that perspective to the team.

* Experience in online business or e-commerce. If you’ve helped operate, manage, or grow an online business, we’d especially love to hear about it.

* Some marketing exposure. You don’t need to be a marketing expert, but you should feel comfortable contributing to marketing discussions.

* Flexibility. You enjoy being involved in both strategic conversations and everyday operational work. Both are equally important to us.

* Clear communication. We appreciate people who can communicate their thoughts and updates clearly and concisely.

* A willingness to ask questions. If something in a brief is unclear, we’d much rather you ask than feel you have to figure everything out on your own.

* Openness to feedback. We believe feedback is part of working well together. We value people who can take suggestions positively, make adjustments, and keep moving forward.

* Availability that overlaps meaningfully with US Eastern and Hawaii working hours. This is an important requirement for the role.



ABOUT AI (PLEASE READ!)



We use AI extensively in our business, including AI agents that help us with real work every day.



But here’s something we want to make clear: You don’t need prior experience with AI agents to apply.



If you’ve used ChatGPT or Claude occasionally but haven’t explored more advanced AI tools, that’s completely fine.



We’re happy to teach you how we use these technologies, and you’ll have access to some powerful tools along the way.



We actually see this as one of the exciting parts of joining our team. You’ll have opportunities to learn practical AI skills and gain experience with tools that are becoming increasingly valuable across different industries.



What matters most to us is your experience, how you think, how you approach your work, and what you can bring to the team.







HOW TO APPLY



We’d love to get to know you a little better!



You don’t need to write a lengthy cover letter. A few thoughtful paragraphs are more than enough, and we appreciate clear, concise answers.



Please tell us three things:

1. Tell us about a project you managed from start to finish. What challenges came up, and how did you handle them?

2. Share a time when you misunderstood a brief or task. What happened, and how did you address it?

3. What experience or perspective would you bring to a conversation about growing an online business?



Please also include your LinkedIn profile and your Upwork profile, if you have one. We review applicants’ work histories, so having these links upfront helps make the process easier for everyone.



We read every application and appreciate hearing about your actual experiences. There’s no need for a perfectly polished or generic response. We’d much rather hear from you in your own words.



We look forward to getting to know you!

title: Shopify Plus Content and Catalogue Manager (B2B) | Full Onsite
description:
Dear valued candidate, ** please answer the questions at the end after reading the job description ** 



Please note that this is a Full Onsite role and we are located at Mandaluyong City (Landmark is the City Hall)



The Shopify Plus Content & Catalogue Manager is responsible for the structure, accuracy, optimisation, and performance of the company’s Shopify product catalogue and collection architecture.

This role owns product data integrity, on-site SEO execution, internal linking logic, and digital merchandising to improve navigation clarity, search visibility, and conversion performance for B2B buyers.

• This is not a social media or paid ads role.

• This is not a developer role.

• This is a catalogue, structure, and optimisation role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Catalogue Management

• Create, update, and maintain product listings (titles, descriptions, variants, images, PDFs).

• Expertise in bulk data management using Shopify CSVs or third-party tools (e.g., Matrixify/Excelify) to manage complex price updates, variant shifts, and mass metafield imports.

• Manage complex variant structures (single units, boxes, cartons, pallet layers).

• Maintain metafields, tags, and product data consistency.

• Ensure naming conventions align with SEO and B2B buying behaviour.

• Prevent duplicate content and structural inconsistencies.

2. Collection & Site Architecture

• Build and maintain logical collection hierarchies.

• Optimise category structures for clarity and search indexing.

• Implement smart collections and filtering systems.

• Maintain internal linking between related products and categories.

• Improve navigation for large SKU environments.

3. On-Site SEO Execution

• Optimise product titles, meta descriptions, and URLs.

• Manage redirects and canonical structures.

• Identify keyword opportunities relevant to B2B search intent.

• Collaborate on structured data/schema implementation (via apps or theme settings).

4. Digital Merchandising

• Optimise collection layouts.

• Improve cross-sell and related product logic.

• Support bulk purchasing strategy visibility (carton/pallet options).

• Manage B2B-specific catalogue logic, including quantity breaks, wholesale pricing tiers, and "Unit of Measure" displays (e.g., Price per Litre or Price per Pallet).

• Monitor product visibility and ranking within collections.

5. Performance Monitoring

• Use Shopify Analytics and GA4 to:

o Monitor product performance

o Identify underperforming collections

o Improve bounce and engagement metrics

• Propose structured improvements based on data.

6. App & Backend Management

• Manage Shopify apps (installation, removal, configuration).

• Test updates before publishing.

• Coordinate with developers where required (no coding required but must understand limitations).

Required Experience

• Minimum 5 years hands-on Shopify-focused experience (Required).

• Minimum 6–8 years total eCommerce experience preferred.

• Experience managing 1,000+ SKUs.

• Strong understanding of:

o Shopify product architecture & Metafields

o Collections (manual & automated)

o Redirect logic & Canonical handling

• Experience in B2B or technical product environments highly preferred.

• Strong structural thinking and taxonomy understanding.

Not Expected

This role does NOT include:

• Custom theme development

• Paid advertising management

• Social media management

• Advanced technical SEO (server-side issues)

• Full UX redesign ownership

•
 marketing automation

KPIs for This Role

1. Catalogue Accuracy & Integrity

• < 1% product data error rate

• 100% compliance with naming convention standards

• Zero duplicate URL or indexing conflicts introduced

• All new products live within agreed SLA (e.g., 48 hours)

2. SEO & Structure Improvement

• Increase indexed product pages without duplication

• Growth in non-branded organic traffic

• Improvement in category ranking positions

• Clean redirect mapping for discontinued products

3. Conversion & Merchandising Metrics

• Improvement in collection conversion rate

• Improvement in product page engagement time

• Increased cross-sell attachment rate

• Increased bulk/carton selection ratio

4. Operational Efficiency

• Time to publish new products

• Accuracy of bulk uploads (Zero-error imports)

• Clean metafield structure compliance

• Reduction in manual rework due to errors



Test: Questions for candidates to answer

1. Shopify experience: How many years of hands-on Shopify/Shopify Plus Admin experience do you have? Please list the Shopify areas/parts you have managed directly.

2. Bulk catalogue update: We need to update prices, product titles, and custom specification fields for 800+ Shopify SKUs. What method would you use?

3. Metafields / tags/catalogue structure: Give an example of how you have used Shopify metafields, tags, collections, variants, or product data fields to improve catalogue structure, filtering, SEO, or customer experience.

4. Product variants and channel management: How would you manage products sold in different sizes, fragrances, colours, pack quantities, or bundle options across Shopify and eBay while keeping the catalogue clean and easy to manage?

5. QA checklist: What checks would you complete before publishing a new product or bulk product update live on Shopify and eBay?

6. AI workflow: How do you use AI tools for eCommerce product content? Please explain your workflow from supplier data to final published copy.

7. Incomplete supplier data question: If supplier product data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear, what is your process for fixing it? What would you verify yourself, what would you not assume, and when would you escalate to the team?

8. Please rewrite the rough supplier product information below into a Shopify product title, short description, five bullet points, SEO title, and meta description. Also list what information you would not include unless verified.



Supplier Product Name: OXY POWER CLEANER / STAIN REMOVER 5LTR

Brand: Kleenmax

SKU: OXY-5L

Barcode: not supplied

Pack Size: 5L bottle

Carton may be 4 bottles? Need confirm

Supplier Notes: “Strong oxygen cleaning formula. Good for offices, bathrooms, bins, kitchens, tiles, grout, carpets, upholstery maybe. Removes stains and smells. Safer than bleach. Eco friendly. Kills 99.9% germs. Hospital grade. Food safe. Can use everywhere. Dilute 1:10 or use direct for heavy stains. Lemon smell or no fragrance? Need check label. Works on urine smell and organic stains.”

Usage Notes: Can be used by cleaners, offices, schools, childcare, gyms, hospitality, commercial bathrooms.

Use on washable hard surfaces.

May be suitable for carpet spotting but should test first.

Warnings: Do not mix with chlorine bleach. Wear gloves. Check SDS before use. Patch test on delicate surfaces.

title: Part-Time SEO Specialist, WordPress & Google Search Console (UK and Middle East B2B websites)
description:
About the role

We are a small B2B food and drink consultancy with two WordPress websites, one for the UK and one for the Middle East. We need an SEO specialist to help both sites rank for our core services and bring in more enquiries.

You’ll work with our website developer, who makes the changes. Your job is to find what needs doing, write clear instructions, and check that it works.

What you’ll do

Manage Google Search Console for both sites: indexing, errors and recrawl requests

Research keywords for a specialist B2B service in the UK and the Gulf

Write on-page SEO briefs (titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links)

Find technical SEO issues (redirects, duplicate pages, missing H1s, page speed)

Look after a Google Business Profile

Report results from GA4 every month



What we need

2+ years of hands-on SEO on WordPress sites using Yoast

Confident with Google Search Console and GA4

Good written English

Reliable communication. You must log your work in a shared Google Sheet and send a short written update every week. This is essential.



How to apply

Start your application with the word “DRINKS”. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Short, specific answers are best, and AI-written answers will be rejected.



In Search Console, an important page shows “Crawled – currently not indexed”. What would you check, and what would you do, step by step?

We need to remove 20 old blog posts from Google without hurting the site. When would you use noindex, and when would you use a 301 redirect? How would you do each in Yoast?

Our service gets very little search volume in the Middle East. How would you find keywords worth targeting?

Tell us about one website you improved: what you changed, and what happened to traffic, rankings or enquiries, with numbers.



Applications without the word “DRINKS” and all four answers won’t be considered.

title: Paid Ads Specialist (Google & Meta)
description:
Paid Ads Specialist (GooJob Title: Performance Marketing Manager

 Location: Remote

 Job Type: Full-time

About Wandering Lion

Wandering Lion is a strategy-led growth studio helping founder-led businesses build premium brands, install scalable growth systems, and generate measurable commercial outcomes — without chaos. We do not sell marketing activity for the sake of it. We build structured growth systems that connect brand, performance, systems, and reporting to real business results.

Our model is disciplined: foundation first, then build, then scale. That means we care deeply about clarity, accountability, and making sure paid media works inside a stronger commercial system — not in isolation.

The Role

We are looking for a commercially sharp Performance Marketing Manager to lead campaign execution, optimisation, and channel development across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other current or emerging paid acquisition platforms.

This role is not limited to today’s core channels. As the business grows, this position may also support expansion into additional advertising ecosystems, marketing technology, AI-enabled tools, automation platforms, and other digital growth systems that improve performance, reporting, and operational efficiency.

This is not a button-pushing media buying role. We want someone who understands that ads amplify clarity — they do not create it — and who can help translate strategy into efficient, measurable growth.

You will work across founder-led brands that need more than clicks and impressions. They need disciplined media execution, better conversion performance, clearer reporting, and someone who understands the commercial outcome behind the spend. Our ideal clients value structure, proof, and accountability, so your work must reflect that standard.

Key Responsibilities

Paid media strategy and planning

 Build channel strategies across Google, Meta, and other relevant paid platforms based on client goals, audience behaviour, customer journey stage, and conversion priorities.

Campaign setup and execution

 Launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across search, display, remarketing, paid social, and future paid channels where appropriate.

Audience, keyword, and market research

 Conduct keyword research, audience segmentation, competitor review, and targeting refinement to improve efficiency and lead quality.

Creative and messaging alignment

 Work closely with strategy and creative to ensure ad messaging reflects the brand, strengthens trust, and supports conversion.

Testing and optimisation

 Run structured tests across headlines, copy, creative, offers, landing pages, audience segments, and funnel stages to improve performance over time.

Budget and bid management

 Allocate spend carefully, adjust bids based on performance, and manage budgets with commercial discipline.

Performance reporting

 Translate campaign and funnel data into clear reporting that explains what happened, what it means, and what we do next.

Technology and AI adoption

 Help identify and implement useful tools, AI software, automation workflows, and platform enhancements that improve campaign performance, efficiency, internal reporting, or client delivery.

Conversion and systems thinking

 Monitor lead quality, conversion paths, attribution, and funnel performance — not just platfor
trics — to support real business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with measurable results

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, attribution, conversion tracking, and optimisation

Confidence learning and adapting to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and digital systems as the role evolves

Ability to think beyond platfor
trics and connect spend to commercial outcomes

Strong communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly

A structured, accountable, detail-driven approach to campaign management

Comfort working in a business that values quality over volume and clarity over noise

Preferred

Experience across service-based businesses, eCommerce, trades, or founder-led brands

Familiarity with landing page optimisation and CRO principles

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations

Google Ads certifications

Meta advertising certifications

Experience using CRM, analytics, and reporting platforms

What Success Looks Like in This Role

Campaigns are well-structured, well-managed, and commercially aligned

Reporting is clear, useful, and trusted by clients

Paid media performance improves through disciplined testing and optimisation

Useful tools and systems are introduced where they genuinely improve efficiency or outcomes

Clients feel confident that spend is being managed with accountability

You contribute to a premium client experience, not just campaign delivery

Why Join Wandering Lion

You’ll be joining a business built around calm authority, commercial clarity, and human confidence. We are not trying to become a high-volume agency. We are building a quality-protected growth studio that integrates brand, performance, and systems under one roof.

That means:

You’ll work on higher-quality engagements

You’ll be part of a strategy-led model, not random execution

You’ll collaborate with a team that values standards, structure, and outcomes

You’ll help build growth systems that genuinely move businesses forward

Before We Proceed

Before we potentially move to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a strong fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team.

1. PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed

 Please share your device specifications, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. Reliable performance and strong internet are essential for day-to-day work.

2. Current employment or side work

 Are you currently employed or doing any freelance or side work? We are open to offshore tea
mbers having multiple roles. What matters most to us is transparency, so we understand your typical schedule and can support you properly.

3. Hubstaff tracker

 Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking? Our whole team operates remotely, including our field and admin staff in Australia. Hubstaff helps us understand time allocation across projects, improve internal reporting, and provide clearer updates to clients.

4. Working hours / availability

 Can you commit to the required hours? Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm Philippines time. We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication.

5. Expected salary (PHP)

 If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP.

6. CV / Resume

 Please attach your CV if you have not already done so.

7. Relevant training / courses

 Please include any relevant training, certifications, or courses you have completed.

8. English level

 Please confirm your English level (C1 or C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.

Team Context

For context, we currently have a team of 10 people in the Philippines, all working from home, and we are continuing to grow. We value honesty, transparency, and teamwork. We are looking for people who are humble, reliable, and easy to work with — because every role matters, and the most important thing is a happy team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.

How to Apply

Please send your CV, a short introduction, and responses to the questions above, along with 2–3 examples of accounts, campaigns, platforms, or systems you have worked on and the commercial outcomes achieved.

Thank you. We look forward to hearing from you.
